tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dngos gzhi'i khrid yig 'og min chen por bgrod pa'i lam bzang

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rdo rje 'chang gis rjes bzung til+li pa'i// gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin nā ro ta pa'i srol// 'dzin skyong spel mkhas mar mi dwags gsum sogs// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag bgyi'o// grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan mnyam med rgya ras dang*// thams cad mkhyen des pad+ma dkar po'i zhabs// chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam rgyal sogs// dpal ldan 'brug pa brgyud par bcas la 'dud// chos dbyings spros mtshan bral ba'i nam mkha' la// ye shes nyi ma khor yug 'char ba'i gzis// sgrub bstan pad tshal ci yang rgyas mdzad pa'i// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor mchod// mdo sngags chu klung ma lus 'dus pa'i bcud// gsang chen bskyed rdzogs rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i snying*// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag nor bu'i phreng*// 'bral med snying gi rgyan du bcang la rings// tshul 'di tshig nyung don rgyas byin che bar// bzhugs gang rang 'dra'i blo rtul rnams kyi ngor// mdo tsam nyung ngu'i ngag gis 'chad pa la// rtsa brgyud bla mas gnang ba sbyin du gsol// zhes mchod par brjod cing bka'i gnang ba sbyin du gsol nas/ 'dir gleng bar bya ba'i gzhi ni/ spyir bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i dgongs bcud/ bye brag tu bla med rgyud sde ma lus pa'i mthar thug rmad byung rgyud kyi bstan bya'i snying po/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na mchog gzigs rnam gnyis su grags pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa'i nying khu/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi grub chen mar mi dwags gsum brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i man ngag gi yang snying*/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gdams ngag gi gzhung shing lta bu bka' rgya can lngar grags pa'i phyi mor bzhugs pa phyag rgya chen po 'di ste/ de yang ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos gdul bya cig car ba'i skal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/

grub chen til+li pa dang paṇa chen nā ro pa la sogs pa'i gong ma rnams kyis gdul bya dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang dag la/ phyag rgya chen po gnyug ma chig chod kyi gdams pa lta thog nas sgom pa 'tshol ba'i lugs su btab par mdzad pas cig car du grol ba thob pa'ang bgrang ba las 'das par byon par snang mod/ 'on kyang da lta'i skabs na gang zag de 'dra srid mtha' ma dkag tsam las/ phal cher dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang 'byung shas che bar dgongs te/ rje mi la dang dwags pos sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba'i gdams pa phyag rgya chen po rnal 'byor bzhi'i lam nas rim gyis bkri ba'i bka' srol btod par mdzad cing*/ dpal phag mo gru pa dang chos rje 'brug pas de nyid gsal rgyas su gsungs pa'i man ngag gi zab gnad mi 'phyugs pa'i slad du/ kun mkhyen pad dkar zhabs kyis sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i khrid kyi rim pa zin bris su btab par mdzad pa las/ 'dir dngos gzhi'i khrid zin gyi dgongs pa ji lta bar 'chad pa la/ gdams ngag gi mtshan dang*/ mtshan de ldan gyi gzhung gnyis las/ dang po gdams ngag gi mtshan la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po spyi'i mtshan ni/ rgya gar skad du/ mahā mu drā zhes pa/ bod skad du/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste/ skad gnyis shan sbyar na/ mahā ni chen po dang*/ mu drā ni phyag rgya zhes bya/ de la smra 'dod pa dag na re/ mu dra'i sgra rgya kho na la 'jug pas de ltar sbyar ba mi 'thad ces kha tshon gcod par byed mod/ mu dra'i sgra phyag gam rgya so sor bsgyur ba dang*/ phyag rgya zhes bsdams te bshad pa'i tshul gnyis yod pa'i phyir dang*/ ma zad phyag gi sgra bsdu ba'i dbang du song ba las shugs kyis 'thon dgos pa'i lung 'og tu 'byung ba ltar bkral ba'i tshul rnams yod pas kha tshon mi chod do// de yang mtshan 'dogs tshul la/ 'debs par byed pa'am btab pa'i don gyis phyag rgyar 'dogs pa ni/

dper na 'jig rten na tham ga lta bus gzhan la rgyas 'debs pa'am btab pas na rgya zer ba ltar/ 'dis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la rgyas 'debs pa'am btab pas na phyag rgya dang*/ mtshan mas mtshon par byed pas phyag rgyar 'dod pa ni/ dper na 'jig rten na go cha la sogs pa'i mtshan mas so so'i bye brag mtshon pa ltar/ 'dis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam gnas lugs mtshon pas na phyag rgya dang*/ mi 'da' bar byed pas phyag rgyar 'dogs pa ni/ dper na 'jig rten na rgyal pos bka' rgya btab pa de las 'khor 'bangs rnams kyis 'da' mi nus pa ltar/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'di las mi 'da' bas na phyag rgya zhes bya/ de dag dang phyogs 'dra ba gzhan yang 'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pa sogs rnam grangs mang ngo*// mtshan don 'grel na/ phyag ni stong pa nyid rang rig pa'i ye shes rang ngo rang gis shes pa'i don dang*/ rgya ni 'khor ba'i rgya gzung 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa las grol zhing*/ des chos thams cad la rgyas 'debs pa'am btab pa'i don dang*/ chen po ni thabs shes dang snang sems sogs zung du 'jug cing gnyis med mnyam pa chen por sbyor ba'i don du gsungs te/ phyag chen thig le las/ 'di ni phyag rgya chen po ste// phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes yin// rgya ni 'khor ba'i chos las grol// chen po zung du 'jug pa'o// zhes dang*/ snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang las// phyag ni gnyis med ye shes ngo yis zin// rgya ni 'khor ba'i mdud pa grol ba ste// chen po zung 'jug sgron me bltams pa las// gzhan gyis ma yin rang grol chos sku'o// zhes so// yang na chos 'di'i gong na gzhan med pa'i don du'ang gsungs te/ gsang ba grub pa las/ phyag rgya chen po rnam sgom pa// de yi gong na gzhan med pa'o// zhes so// gzhan yang dus 'khor bka' 'grel pad+ma can las/

phyag rgya zhes pa ni 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyed par mdzad pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin la/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'am/ mi 'pho ba'i bde bas bde ba la rgyas btab pas na phyag rgya ste/ las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya las khyad par du gyur pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i bag chags dang bral bar gyur pas na chen po'o// zhes gsungs/ gser sdings pa'i theg sgron las ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i nges tshig ni// las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa rnams// rang grol sems nyid chos sku ru// mjal ba'i phyir na phyag ces bya// mtshan ma'i rnam par rtog pa yis// 'da' bar mi nus phyir na rgya// mtshan nyid theg dang bya spyod sogs// theg pa kun las che bas na// chen po zhes ni brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs pa sogs mang ngo*// don bsdu na/ rje sgam po pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das rnams chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang las mi 'da' bar rtogs pa ni phyag go /cir snang ci srid thams cad gnyug ma'i don las mi 'da' bas na rgya'o// chos nyid rang grol du rtogs pas na chen po'o// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// de sgom pa ni/ lam sgom pa thams cad kyi mchog rab yin pa'i tshul/ mai tri pa'i de nyid bcu pa las/ thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor ba// sgom pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa// phyag rgya chen po mnyam sbyor ba// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro// phyag rgya chen po 'di la dbye na/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po gsum ste/ dang po gzhi phyag rgya chen po ni/ spyir chos thams cad kyi chos nyid gdod nas spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i stong pa nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi khyab bdag tu gyur pa dang*/ bye brag tu rang sems kyi gshis gdod ma'i gnas lugs bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa de dag la zer/

gnyis pa lam phyag rgya chen po ni/ smin grol gyi lam la brten nas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i 'od gsal stong pa nyid du rtogs shing*/ myong thog tu rang ngo shes pa'i lta sgom khyad par can de la zer/ gsum pa 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po ni/ de lta'i gzhi'i phyag chen de nyid lam phyag chen gyis goms par byas pa las/ gnyis snang phra zhing phra ba'ang dag nas sgrib bral dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa de la zer ro// de las gzhi phyag rgya chen po ni rtogs bya dang*/ lam phyag rgya chen ni rtogs byed dang*/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po ni thob bya yin no// de las 'dir lam phyag rgya chen po yin/ de la smin lam dang grol lam gnyis las phyi ma ste/ de la bshad pa tshig gi skor/ gdams ngag nyams len gyi skor/ rtogs pa byin rlabs kyi skor te gsum/ dang po bshad pa tshig gi skor ni/ grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos tshan nyi shu rtsa lnga rnams so// gnyis pa gdams ngag nyams len gyi skor ni/ cig car ba'i lam gtso bor bton pa thog babs/ thod brgal gyi lam gtso bor bton pa bsam gtan thun 'jog rim gyis pa'i lam gtso bor bton pa rtogs brjod gser phreng rnams so// gsum pa rtogs pa byin rlabs kyi skor ni/ phyag rgya chen po gnyug ma chig chod/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa la sogs pa rnams so// gnyis pa bye brag gi mtshan ni/ rgya gar skad du/ sa ha dza na yu dzi ra zhes pa/ bod skad du/ lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes bya ste/ skad gnyis shan sbyar na/ sa ha ni lhan cig dang*/ dza na ni rab tu skye ba dang*/ yu dzi ra ni sbyor ba zhes pa'i byings so// mtshan don cung zad 'grel na/ de'ang chos can brtan g.yos bsdus pa'i dngos po thams cad dang rang rang gi chos nyid de bzhin nyid dag

ye gdod ma nas lhan cig tu skyes shing gnas pas na lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ste/ brtag gnyis las/ lhan cig skyes pas gang skyes pa// lhan cig skyes par de brjod bya// zhes dang*/ ḍom bhi pa'i lhan cig skyes grub las/ lhan cig skyes gyur de yi phyir// brjod bral lhan cig skyes par bshad// ces gsungs// de la dbye na/ spyir gzhi lam 'bras bu'i lhan skyes gsum du phye ba dang*/ brtag gnyis las rang bzhin lhan skyes dang zhu bde lhan skyes gnyis su phye ba dang*/ grub snying gi skor nas de'i thog tu bde stong lhan skyes bsnan te gsum du phye ba sogs mang ngo*/ 'dir ni sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa dang snang ba lhan cig skyes pa gnyis su phye ste/ rje dwags pos/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// de phyir snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes// zhes gsungs/ de las sems byung gi rtog pa sna tshogs pa dang snang ba so sor 'byed de/ sems nyid lhan skyes dang*/ snang ba lhan skyes dang*/ rnam rtog lhan skyes bcas gsum du yang gsungs te/ rje sgom chung gis/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i dngos// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rlabs// dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i don// zhes so// de la sbyor ba'i tshul ni/ gong smos bzhin du gdod ma nas lhan cig skyes shing dbyer med du gnas kyang*/ de'i tshul sngar ma rtogs pas bzang ngan dang tha dad du 'dzin pa las/ de dag snying po don gyi gdams pas gdod ma nas lhan cig tu skyes shing gnas par ngo sprod nas/ de thams cad dbyer med pa'i ngo bo sems nyid kho nar sbyor bar byed pas na lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes bya ste/ dpal zla 'od gzhon nus/ sems dang rnam rtog chos sku gsum// dang por lhan cig skyes pa ste// gdams pas gcig tu sbyor ba la// lhan cig skyes sbyor mi zer ram// zhes dang*/

rje phag grus/ sems dang rnam rtog chos sku gsum// dang por lhan cig skyes pa de// gdams pas sems su sbyor ba'i phyir// lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes su bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar dang*/ gzhan yang tha mal pa'i sems snang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su sbyor bas de skad du btags pa sogs/ mdor na gsal stong snang stong rig stong bde stong sogs gnyis chos su snang ba mtha' dag zung 'jug lhan skyes su sbyor ba la zer ro// 'di'i gzhung ni/ chos rje dwags pos mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor tshigs bcad rkang pa gsum pa dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi pa gnyis la snga ma zer// rje phag grus mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor tshigs bcad ma dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis ma zung la bar pa zer/ rje rgya ras kyis mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor tshigs bcad ma dang*/ gnas lugs dri med/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim rnams la phyi ma zer te don du sgom rim bsdus 'bring rgyas par phye ba tsam mo// gnyis pa mtshan de ldan gyi gzhung la/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi sgom rim phyi ma ltar te/ 'di la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la'ang thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro dang*/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro ste gsum las/ dang po thun mong gi sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam bzhi gzhan du bshad zin pa ltar dang*/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa la skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa la rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa la maṇ+ḍal/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor te/ de dag kyang gzhan du bshad pa ltar gnad smin sngon du 'gro bas thugs yid bsres nas mnyam bzhag la 'jug par bya'o// gsum pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro sgo gsum gyi gnad bstan pa las/

dang po lus kyi gnad ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ lus bsrangs rdo rje'i skyil krung bya// yid ni rtse gcig phyag rgya che/ zhes dang*/ rmad byung rgyud las/ lus ni rdo rje'i skyil mo krung*// sgal tshigs rin chen rtsar la brgyus// mthongs ka rgyun du yangs pa dang*// stong lko shin tu sba bar bya// lce ni yar rkan nyid du gtad// mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte 'og btsir// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ rkang pa g.yas phyi nas steng du bton pa'i rdo rje'i skyil krung dam lhod ran par bca' ba dang gcig lag g.yas steng dang g.yon 'og tu byas nas brtsegs pa'i mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og tu bca' ba dang gnyis/ sgal tshigs mu tig rtsar la rgyus pa'am gser gyi dong tse brtsegs pa ltar drangs por bsrangs pa dang gsum/ ro stod rgod gshog ltar rgyab tu 'phul nas phrag pa'i dang ru kha phyir dgye zhing mthongs kha yangs par bya ba dang bzhi/ mgrin pa cung zad gug pa'i og skos ol mdud non tsam byas pa dang lnga/ lce rtse cung zad ya rkan la gtad de so mchu bar yod tsam bya ba dang drug spyir rig pa dbang pos bsgyur zhing khyad par mig gi dbang pos bsgyur bas mig mi 'dzum zhing mi 'gul bar gnya' shing gang tsam gyi thad du blta ba dang bdun po la rnam snang gi chos bdun zhes bya ste/ de ni rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i bzhugs stangs dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir ram/ gzugs phung sbyangs nas rnam par snang mdzad du dag par byed pa'i phyir yang de skad du btags pa'o// gzhan yang grol lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom dus 'dir lus gnad la bde yangs lhod gsum 'dzom pa zhig dgos te/ rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ 'byung bzhi'i lus kyi 'dug tshul ni// bde dang yangs dang lhod dang gsum// zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i lus gnad bca' tshul legs pa las byung ba'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan ni/ gong ma'i gsungs las/

rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char// zhes dang*/ lus drang bas rtsa drang*/ rtsa drang bas rlung drang*/ rlung drang bas thig le drang*/ thig le drang bas sems zin// zhes dang*/ yang lus drang bas rtsa drang*/ rtsa drang bas rlung drang*/ rtsa rlung gnad du tshud pas sems zin// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang byed las kyi sgo nas bsam gtan gyi chos lnga zhes rnam par bzhag ste/ de'ang skyil krung gis thur sel gyi rlung gsang gnas na gnas pa de zin pa dang*/ mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas me mnyam gyi rlung lte bar gnas pa de zin pa dang*/ sgal tshigs bsrangs pa dang dang kha dgye bas khyab byed kyi rlung tshig rnams la gnas pa de zin pa dang*/ mgrin pa gug pas gyen rgyu'i rlung brang la gnas pa de zin pa dang*/ lce ya rkan la sbyar ba dang lta stangs kyis srog 'dzin gyi rlung snying gar gnas pa de zin/ de ltar rtsa ba'i rlung lnga zin cing dbu mar tshud par byed pas yan lag gi rlung lnga sogs las rlung mtha' dag dbu mar tshud nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char te sa lam gyi mngon rtogs rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mtshan brjod dang rmad byung rgyud tshig mthun par/ rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa'o// yang lus gnad bca' tshul nyes pa'i skyon ni/ lus bsnye ba dang mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon du yo ba sogs byed na/ rtsa 'chus rlung 'chus su song nas sems las su mi rung ba dang*/ gzung rtog 'dzin rtog je mang je rags su 'gro ba dang*/ pho mo ma ning gi gdon dang*/ tsha grang 'dus pa'i nad sogs 'byung nyen yod pas/ bla ma'am mched grogs rgyus can la bsten nas lus gnad bca' tshul legs par bslab bo// de dus lus kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i bya bas dben pas na de la lus dben nam/ lus mi 'gul bar ri rgyal lta bur gnas pas na lus mi g.yo ba dang*/ lus ma bcos rang lugs su bzhag pas na lus rang babs su gnas pa zhes kyang bya'o// gnyis pa ngag gi gnad ni/

spyir smra ba la dga' ba ni nyes pa'i sgo dang nyon mongs pa thams cad skye ba'i gzhir gyur pas na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang smra ba la dga' ba'i nyes pa brgyad cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa gsungs shing*/ rgyud sde rnams las kyang sngags kyi nus pa'i dgag byas smra bcad bya dgos par gsungs la/ smra bcad byas pa bzlas brjod kyi mchog kyang yin te/ rgyud las/ brjod du med pa bzlas pa'i mchog /ces dang*/ rdo rje gdan pas kyang*/ mi g.yo mi smra bzlas pa'i mchog /ces gsungs la/ de la thog mar 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug ste dug gsum dang*/ pho mo ma ning ste gdon gsum dang*/ tsha grang 'dus pa ste nad gsum/ gzhan yang sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs sogs/ mdor na byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad du ba'i rnam pas phyir 'thon par bsam nas rlung ro lan gsum spyi ltar dor/ de nas phal gyi long gtam lta ci kha ton bzlas brjod kyang mi bya bar smra ba ngag gi sgo bcad dgos/ de yang grol lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom dus rlung sna bug nas mi gtong bar kha nas dal bus rgyur bcug pas/ las rlung rta rgod long ba lta bu de rang mal du gnas par 'gyur la/ de'i dbang gis de la brten pa'i sems skyes bu 'phye bo lta bu 'di yang yul thog tu g.yo bar byed mi nus pas ting nge 'dzin las su rung bar 'gyur te/ gdan bzhi las/ rlung dang ngag ni g.yo med pa// de yis bsam gtan 'bras bu 'grub// ces gsungs/ de dus ngag gi phyi nang gsang ba'i bya bas dben pas na de la ngag dben nam/ rlung rngam pa dang sgra can dang rgod bag tu mi rgyu bas na ngag mi g.yo ba dang*/ rlung rang mal du zin pas na ngag rang babs su gnas pa zhes kyang bya'o// gsum pa sems gnad ni/ de yang 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur ba'i sems kyi chos nyid 'di ma shes na gzhan byas pa thams cad don med yin te/

klu sgrub kyis/ khyod kyis thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis// sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs// zhes dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na// bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang*// de dag don med gyi nar 'khyams// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// des na thog mar dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad de sems rang babs su bzhag dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i lus ngag gi gnad dang ldan pa'i ngang nas sngar de dang de lta bu byas so snyam pa sogs 'das pa'i rjes su mi mno/ da gzhi nas bya rgyu'i las ka 'di dang 'di lta bu yod snyam pa sogs ma 'ongs pa'i sngon bsus te mi bsam/ ched du blos sgro btags nas mi bsgom/ stong pa nyid ces cang med pa'i stong rkyang du yang mi blta/ da ltar mig sogs sgo lnga'i yul du gang snang yang*/ 'di yin zhes sgrub pa dang*/ 'di min zhes dgag pa'i rtog dpyod gang yang mi byed par kha nang du log nas/ dper na bu chung lhug par gnas pa bzhin du sems ma bcos rang babs su 'jog pa ste/ de lta'i sems kyi rang gshis lhug par 'jog pa de las skad cig kyang ma yengs par bya'o// de yang rje dwags pos/ 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyod/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da ltar gyi shes pa yang dag rnal mar tsan gyis zhog de la 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyod zer tsa na/ 'o skol blo rnam rtog snga ma'i phyir mi 'brang ba yin/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu zer tsa na/ 'o skol gyi rnam par rtog pa phyi ma'i sngon mi bsu ba yin/ da ltar gyi shes pa rnal mar tsan gyis zhog zer tsa na/ da lta gang du'ang mi dmigs pa la zer ba yin/ sems ma bcos na gsal/ chu ma rnyogs na dwangs bya ba yin pas ma bcos pa'i ngang la rang gar tsan gyis zhog ces gsungs pa'i don dang*/ sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis/ bsam dang bsam bya thams cad yongs su dor nas su// ji ltar bu chung lhug par gnas pa bzhin// bla ma'i lung la bsgrims te gus 'bad na// lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med// ces dang*/

til+li pas/ mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing*// mi bsgom mi sems rab babs bzhag /ces gsungs/ de yang bsdu na/ chos kyi rgyal po zla 'od gzhon nus/ ma yengs pa ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// ma yengs pa ni dge ba'i bshes dang gnyen// ma yengs pa ni gdams pa kun gyi gtso// zhes dang*/ ma yengs rgyun gyi dran pa 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas gzhung lam yin// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// de dus yid kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i bya bas dben pas na de la sems dben nam/ shes pa yul drug gi thog tu mi g.yo bas na sems mi g.yo ba dang*/ sems nyid ma bcos par bzhag pas na sems rang babs su bzhag pa zhes kyang bya'o/ te lo pas/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thong rnal mar zhog /ngag gi smra brjod ma smra brag cha 'dra// yid la mi bsam la bzla'i chos la ltos// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// de nas bzung dus rgyun du dran pa gal che ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ dbang phyug lus gtogs dran pa bde gshegs kyis// bgrod pa gcig bu'i lam du nye bar bstan// de la bsgrims te mngon par bsrung bgyi zhing*/ dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas so// de'i dran pa ni yengs pa ste/ de yang spyir dran pa la dbye ba mang yang*/ 'dir re zhig brten par bya ba ni yul nges kyi dran pa khyad par can te/ mngon pa kun btus las/ dran pa gang zhe na/ 'dris pa'i dngos po la sems brjed pa med pa ste/ sems rnam par mi g.yeng ba'i las can no// zhes gsungs pa de'o// de'i don ni/ dmigs pa'i khyad par sngar 'dris kyi dngos po la dmigs pa/ 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par de nyid sems kyis brjed pa med pa/ byed las kyi khyad par rnam par mi g.yeng ba'i las can te mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa zhig la bya ba yin no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thun mong gi nyams len dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len te gnyis/

de las snga ma la thun mong gi nyams len zer ba'i don ni/ mdo lam gyi dngos bstan dang thun mong du gyur pa shas che ba'i phyir dang*/ phyi ma la thun mong ma yin pa zer ba'i don yang*/ mdo lam gyi dngos bstan las khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags bla med kyi bstan don shas che ba'i phyir ro// de'ang thun mong ba'i lam thams cad zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis su bsdus nas de dag rim pa ltar 'dir rtse gcig dang spros bral yin zhing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam thams cad slob pa'i zung 'jug dang mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gnyis su bsdus nas de dag kyang rim pa ltar 'dis ro gcig dang sgom med yin no// de las dang po thun mong gi nyams len la/ sgom gyi rtsa ba zhi gnas kyi nyams btsal nas rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba dpyad nas lhag mthong ngos bzung ste spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa ste gnyis las/ dang po sgom gyi rtsa ba zhi gnas kyi nyams btsal nas rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la/ rten can dang rten med gnyis las/ dang po rten can la rlung med dang rlung can gnyis las/ dang po rlung med la'ang ma dag rde'u shing bu la rten bca' ba dang*/ dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsungs thugs la rten bca' ba ste gnyis las/ dang po ma dag rde'u shing bu la rten bca' tshul ni/ thog mar blo ldog rnam bzhi nas bzung ste thun mong thun min gyi sngon 'gro cha tshang ngam/ bsdu na skyabs sems dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gzhung bzhin bsgoms nas/ ma nam bzhi skor spyi dang*/ khyad par du/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud la zab lam gyi rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa skyed du gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas dbang bzhi blangs pa'i mthar/

bla ma rdo rje 'chang yas mas nas 'od du zhus te thugs kyi thad kar 'od sngon po'i gong bu zhig tu gyur pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs snying dbus su sib kyis thim pas/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam/ de nas gong bshad ltar sgo gsum rang babs su bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ 'di ltar rang gi mdun du lta stangs kyi thad kar rde'u 'am shing bu chung ngu zhig dmigs pa'i rten du bzhag de'ang kha dog dkar la 'tsher ba bzhag na mig la gnod pas ran pa zhig btsal/ dmigs rten de la mig dang shes pa mi 'gyur ba'i brtod phur du bzung nas bzhag la/ de dus dmigs rten de nyid la btsir 'dzin du byed nas kha dog dang dbyibs sogs la bsam mno mi gtong bar dmigs rten mthong tsam shes tsam du bzhag de las shes pa phyir yang mi spro zhing nang du'ang mi sdud par/ dmigs rten de kho na la rtse gcig tu gtad nas mnyam par bzhag de skabs yud tsam re gnas cha rnyed na/ gnas bzhin pa'i ngang de nyid 'phro bcad la cung zad ngal gsos/ yang sngar bzhin gnas su 'jug nas bsgom/ de ltar thun yun thung la thun grangs mang bar byas pa'i don ni/ yun thung bas sgom la skyon mi 'byung zhing grangs mang bas ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan rang rgyud la skye ba'i gnad yod pas te/ khrid rkang phyi ma rnams bsgom dus kyang 'di bzhin bya la/ ma zad sgom dang bzang gyes byas pas phyis sgom 'dod pa 'ong bas kyang yin no// yang bla ma spyi bor bsgom nas sangs rgyas dngos su mos pa'i blos sngar bzhin ma nam mkha' mas gsol ba gdab/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes 'dod don gsol nas/ dbang bzhi'am sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub zhus nas bdag nyid la bstim/ thugs yid 'dres par bsam la ji tsam mnyam par 'jog nus pa de tsam du bzhag par bya'o// de la kha cig 'di snyam du bsam ste/

sems gnas yid kyi shes pa'i steng du sgrub dgos kyis/ rde'u dang shing bu mthong ba'i dbang shes la brten nas sems gnas sgrub pa mi rigs so snyam na skyon med de/ dbang shes la brten nas yid shes g.yo ba shas che ba'i phyir/ 'dir mig gi dbang po mi g.yo ba'i lta stangs byas pas mig gi dbang shes kyang mi g.yo zhing*/ des rna ba'i dbang shes sogs gzhan rnams kyang mi g.yo bar 'gyur ba dang*/ des yid shes kyang g.yo shas chung ba'i gnad kyis so// yang rde'u shing bu la dmigs rten byas nas sems gnas sgrub pa 'di ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa'i thabs la rmongs pa'o snyam na/ de ni las dang po pa dge ba la cher ma goms shing*/ dkon mchog la dad gus kyi bag chags mi bzang ba dag gis/ thog ma nyid nas dag pa'i rten la sems 'dzin par byed mi nus pas/ re zhig bag chags 'dres goms che ba'i dbang gis dmigs rten phal ba la sems 'dzin bde zhing dgos don 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ thog mar ma dag rde'u shing bu la dran rten byas pa la skyon med de/ sgom rim du yang zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa la nges pa med par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ til+li pas/ lta stangs sems 'dzin yan lag du ma yis// rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar du gcun// zhes dang*/ lhag par chos rje ras pas/ rten ni rde'u shing bu dang*// mar me bla ma dag la gtad// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de skabs sems kyi ngang tshul 'phral la gang dang gang byung ba rnams bla ma nyams myong can la zhu zhing bsgom par bya'o// bying ba byung na mig gi lta stangs dpangs bstod la ri rtse lta bu'i sa snang g.yer che sa dang rlung 'ong sar bsgom/ rmugs pa byung na gzhan snga ma bzhin la dran pa dang shes bzhin bzhur nas gsal ngar bton/ yul yid du 'ong ba'i thog tu rgod pa byung na rtsig pa dang rib ma sogs kyis bsgribs pa'i sa 'gol sar 'dug mig gi lta stangs smad cing lus sems lhod cha gtso bor byas nas bsgoms pas skyon de dag sel bar 'gyur ro// mthar thun bsdu ba na dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pa ji nus gdab par bya'o// gnyis pa dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsungs thugs la rten bca' ba la/

sku gzugs brnyan la rten bca' ba dang*/ gsung yig 'bru la rten bca' ba dang*/ thugs thig le la rten bca' ba ste gsum las/ dang po sku gzugs brnyan la rten bca' ba'i tshul ni/ de yang skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa nas thugs yid bsres te mnyam par bzhag pa'i bar gong bzhin byas/ de nas sngar ma dag pa'i rten rde'u shing bu'i tshab tu dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rten la dmigs pa ste/ de yang sku rten bsgom mi shes pa'i rigs la bslab tshul ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lugs su blugs pa lta bu'i 'bul ma'am ri mos bris pa lta bu cha tshad legs shing grums ral la sogs pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pas mthong na mi mthun pa med pa zhig bkur bsti dang bcas mdun du bzhugs su gsol/ rgyal ba'i sku brnyan mjal du yod pa bsod nams che snyam du spro ba bsring*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o snyam du 'dun pa bskyed rjes/ mig dang shes pa gzhan du ma yengs par de nyid la rtse gcig tu gtad/ sku gzugs kyi bzo sgros gtsang min dang rgyu'i khyad par sogs la bsam mno mi gtong bar/ sku rten de la dran rten tsam zhig byas nas sems rang babs su bzhag rnam rtog shar byung na dran pas ngos 'dzin/ yengs shor na slar 'dun pas 'tsho skyong byed de bsgom/ lus mi bde ba dang*/ sku mi mthong ba dang*/ sems gnas skyong mi thub pa sogs byung na 'phro bcad de ngal gsos la/ slar gsol ba btab ste sngar bzhin bskyang ngo*// de ltar sku gzugs dngos la sems zin pa na/ de dang rang gi bar du snang brnyan de 'dra ba zhig bsgom la sems 'dzin/ de la gnas na sku gzugs de mig sngon mi 'jog par yid kyis bsgom par bya ste/ rang gi mdun du rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i steng du ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku gser btso ma'i ri bo nyid 'od kyis 'khyud pa dang 'dra bar sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'i sku las 'od zer dpag med 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ ngur smrig gi kha dog can gyi chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de yang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dngos su bzhugs pa lta bur bsams shing*/ yon tan rjes su dran pa'i dad 'dun bskyed rjes sngar bzhin sems 'dzin pa ste rgyun du sangs rgyas yid la dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya'o// de la goms pa na dmigs pa'i rtsal 'don du sku'i bongs tshod mi tshad tsam pa nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bar che bskyed dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nas mtshon gang gi bar chung ngur sdud pa'ang nus na bya'o// de ltar dang po 'dres pa'i bag chags la bslab/ de nas rgyal ba'i sku dngos bcas la bslab/ de nas dngos med yid kyis sgom pa'i skur bslab pa ni blo dman rim gyis khrid pa'i thabs so// gzhan du dang po nas dmigs pa gsal ba zhig na/ 'dris pa'i bag chags la bslab pa dang*/ dngos bcas kyi sku la sems gtod pa sngon du 'gro mi dgos so// tshul 'di ni bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis khyim bdag rgan mo zhig la stong pa nyid kyi don bstan pa ma 'tshal nas/ ston pas/ khyod ci la sems 'gro zhes dri ba'i tshul mdzad pa na/ rgan mos/ bdag bcos ldan 'das nyid kyi sku la sems 'gro zhes gsol pas/ ston pas de ni shin tu legs te/ de ltar na bdag nyid bsgoms nas de la sems gtod cig ces gsungs pa ltar byas pas ring por ma thogs par zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs par bshad pa sogs kyi don dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las kyang*/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sku lus kyis// 'jig rten mgon po rab tu mdzes pa ni// dmigs pa de la gang gis sems gtod pa// byang chub sems dpa' de mnyam bzhag ces bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// 'di dus bying rmugs kyi skyon byung na/

lta stangs dang sems dpangs bstod nas sangs rgyas kyi sku'i dbu'i gtsug tor ram mdzod spu'am zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin/ 'phro rgod kyi skyon byung na lta stangs dang sems dpangs smad nas/ rgyal ba'i sku'i lte ba dang zhabs pad sogs la sems 'dzin pas sel la/ bying rgod med pa'i tshe sku yongs rdzogs la sems gtad de bsgom mo// mthar thun bsdu ba na dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo zhing smon lam ji nus gdab bar bya'o// gnyis pa gsung yig 'bru la rten bca' ba'i tshul ni/ skyabs sems dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gong bzhin bsgoms nas thugs yid bsres la mnyam par bzhag de nas rang mdun thad ka'i nam mkha' la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dwangs shing nya gang ba che chung sran ma tsam zhig gi steng du hūm̐ yig kha dog lnga ldan nam sngon po spus bris pa lta bu phra mo 'od lnga 'phro ba zhig dmigs te de la sems gtad/ yengs shor na 'dun pa bsgrims te dmigs pa bsgom/ rgyun ring bas bying ba byung na 'phro bcad de ngal gsos nas sngar bzhin bsgom/ 'dir gong ma dag bying rmugs sel thabs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar ba dang*/ de'i steng du hūm̐ yig kyang dkar la 'tsher ba zhig tu bsgom/ rgod pa byung na hūm̐ yig mthing nag nyon mongs pa che na dmar po/ rgyun du kha dog lnga ldan bsgom zhes kyang gsungs/ de dag ni slob dpon byang chub bzang pos/ kha phyir bltas pas thob pa la gnyis te/ khyad par can dang phal pa'o// de la khyad par can la gnyis te/ sku la dmigs pa dang gsung la dmigs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// mthar dge rtsa bsngo zhing smon lam ji nus gdab par bya'o// gsum pa thugs thig le la rten bca' ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gong smos ji bzhin sngon du btang nas/ rang gi mdun mkhar gnya' shing gang tsam gyi thad na/ thig le kha dog sngon po dbyibs bya'i sgo nga 'dra ba/

che chung sran ma tsam pa dwangs gsal sgrib pa med pa 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba dang bcas pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can la sngar bzhin sems 'dzin bya/ de la cung zad goms pa na dmigs pa'i rtsa 'don du thig le bya sgong tsam pa nas stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i bar che bskyed dang*/ stong gsum tsam pa nas yungs 'bru tsam gyi bar chung ngur bsdus pa'ang nus na bya/ bying rmugs byung na thig le'i 'od kyis rang lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gsal bar bsam/ rgod pa byung na thig le nag po 'od 'phro ba la sems gtad pas sel lo// de ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ thig le'i gzugs la mi shigs pa// ye shes 'od kyi rnam 'khrigs ldan// zhes dang*/ in+d+ra bhu tis/ 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kun// thig le'i gong bu gcig byas nas// stong gsum ma lus khyab pa dang*// yungs kar tsam du bsdu bar bya// zhes gsungs pa dang phyogs mthun no// mthar dge rtsa bsngo zhing smon lam ji nus gdab par bya'o// de ltar sku gsung thugs la dmigs pa rim par bshad pa'ang go rim tsam yin la/ gang zag gcig gis gsum po rim can du bslab dgos nges ni ma yin zhing*/ 'ga' zhig rim can gyis bogs su 'gyur ba yod pas de ltar bstan pa don med pa'ang ma yin no// gnyis pa rlung can ni/ de yang sems rlung gi bzhon pa can yin pas rlung 'ching na sems 'ching ba'i gnad kyis rlung can gyi khrid ston pa 'di la/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa la brten pa dang*/ bum pa can la brten pa ste gnyis las/ dang po rdo rje'i bzlas pa la brten pa la'ang nang gses lnga yod pa las/ dang po bgrang ba la bslab pa ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du btang nas lus gnad dang sems gnad sngar ltar bzhag ste/ thog mar ma dag pa'i rtsa lam du rgyu ba'i las kyi rlung dang nyon mongs pa'i rlung sogs dag pa'i rten 'brel du rlung ro lan gsum spyi ltar bsal/ de nas rang gi sna bug gi rlung rngam pa dang sgra can dang rgod bag med par rang babs kyis dbugs nang du rngub pa dang phar dal bus rang 'gros du dbyung ba la sems gtad cing mngon par 'du bya ba gzhan med par/

dbugs 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gcig tu byas pa'i khug pa gcig dang gnyis la sogs pa nas bdun tsam gyi bar bgrang zhing ngal gso/ de ni nyer gcig tsam dang*/ lnga bcu tsam dang*/ brgya phrag re tsam sogs goms pa dang bstun grangs spar nas bgrang*/ mthar nyin zhag gcig la dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rdzogs pa'i bar du bgrang bar bya'o// de skabs goms 'dris chung ba'i dbang gis sems yengs shing lus gnad dang rlung gnad skyon can du song na/ slar rlung ro bsal te gnad rnams bcos rjes sngar bzhin bgrang ba la bslab bo// de ltar bgrangs pas gtso bo sems la gnas cha rnyed pa dang*/ zhar byung du nyin zhag gcig la dbugs phyi nang du ji tsam rgyu ba'i grangs la nges pa rnyed cing mkhas par 'gyur ro// de nas sa snying 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar na dran pa'i dbang gis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba la rtog pa skye na/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du bgrang ba dang*// zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ rnal 'byor pas ni mnyam bzhag pas// 'jug pa'i rlung ni bgrang bar bya// ji srid 'bum la sogs pa'i grangs// sgra dang bral bar rtag tu bzla// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// gnyis pa 'byung 'jug la bslab pa ni/ de nas ji srid du 'byung zhing 'jug pa de dag lus kyi cha shas thams cad nas rgyu'am phyogs gcig kho na las rgyu ba gang yin zhes rtogs cing dpyod de dbugs 'jug pa dang dbyung ba'i rjes su 'gro bas gzhig pa na/ lus kyi cha shas nas sam tshogs pa gang las kyang rgyu ba ma yin par shes te dbugs kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid la mkhas par 'gyur ro// gsum pa 'gro 'ong gnas gsum la bslab pa ni/ de yang sngar ltar dbugs kyi grangs bgrang ba dang 'byung 'jug la gzhig pa'i bsam blo mi gtong bar/ dbugs dang shes pa bsres te dbugs lte ba nas sna rtse'i bar 'gro ba dang*/

sna rtse nas lte ba'i bar du 'ong ba dang*/ lte 'og tu gnas pa ste de gsum gyi rang bzhin la rtse gcig tu blta bar bya'o// des kyang gtso bo sems la gnas cha rnyed pa dang*/ zhar byung du sa rlung ser po/ chu rlung dkar po/ me rlung dmar po/ rlung gi rlung nag po// nam mkha'i rlung sngon po ste rlung lnga so so'i kha dog mthong ba dang*/ sna sgo nas phyir sor bcu drug gi mtshams tshun nam mkha'i rlung rgyu ba dang*/ bco lnga tshun rlung gi rlung rgyu ba dang*/ bcu bzhi tshun me rlung*/ bcu gsum tshun chu rlung*/ bcu gnyis tshun sa rlung*/ de rnams phyir sor tshad je thung dang nang gi lus la je ring du rgyu ba ste rlung lnga'i ring thung ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ngo*// bzhi pa 'byung chen lnga'i rlung la brtag pa ni/ de ltar kha dog dang ring thung zin nas 'byung ba chen po lnga'i rlung so sor brtag tshul 'di lta ste/ dper na sna g.yas pa nas sa rlung rgyu ba'i dus der sa'i rlung ser por mthong bar 'gyur la/ de dus sa rlung dang shes pa bsres te bsgoms pas ci zhig na sa rlung gi stobs nus zin par gsungs la/ des mtshon nas so sor ma 'dres par brtags pas 'byung lnga'i rlung gi stobs nus zin pa dang*/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba'i 'phel 'grib kyang shes par 'gyur ro// zhes so// lnga pa 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bslab pa ni/ sna sgo'i rlung phyir 'gro ba'i dus rlung de oṃ yig dkar po'i phreng ba oṃ gyi sgra gdangs can du 'thon par dmigs/ de nang du 'ong ba'i tshe hūm̐ yig sngon po'i phreng bar lam gyis song ba hūm̐ gi sgra gdangs dang bcas sna nas zhugs par bsam/ lte 'og tu gnas pa'i tshe āḥyig dmar po gcig gam du mar bsgyur ba āḥ'i sgra gdangs can du gnas par bsam pa ste/ de ltar 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum du bsgyur nas de dag gi 'phro 'du gnas gsum la dmigs pas/

dbugs phyi rol du mi rgyu bar rang mal du gnas pas sems kyang yul la 'phyan par mi 'gyur bas/ de'i tshe rgyu ba phyir chad kyi 'char sgo zad pa mngon du 'gyur bar gsungs so// de ni rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams// sngags ni bzung zhing bzlas brjod bya// de yis dngos grub myur 'grub 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// gnyis pa bum pa can la brten pa ni/ lus gnad legs par bcas te rlung ro lan gsum spyi ltar dor nas/ steng rlung sna bug gnyis nas dal bul brngubs te lte 'og tu bskyur/ 'og rlung yar cung zad 'then nas kha sbyor du ji tsam thub pa'i bar bzung*/ mi bde ba med tsam du rgod bag dang sgra med par sil gyis btang*/ de ltar phyi nas brngub pa dang*/ nang du bsdom pa dang*/ phyir btang ba'i bar gyi gnas skabs thams cad dang*/ khyad par nang du ci tsam bsdam pa'i skabs na sems ma yengs par rtog med du had de sem me hu rer gnas pa'i rgyun bzung ba la 'bad do// de lta bu yang dang po rlung bum can bdun dang nyer gcig sogs kyi mtshams ci rigs la ngal gso zhing goms nas yun je ring dang grangs je mang la gtang*/ des sems rgod du song na ma yengs tsam ma gtogs sems khong glod/ des kyang 'tshub na dub pa yin pas dub bsangs ci rigs bya/ mgo 'khor ba'am sems yer na rlung kha skyes pa yin pas bza' btung bcud chen brten cing bku mnye bya/ de dus rlung bsdam pa'i gnad kyis bying ba shas cher mi 'byung la/ byung na lta stangs dpangs bstod nas hur 'don sogs bya/ rtog pa 'og 'gyus lta bur ma song bar dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas rtog pa phra mo re gnyis 'char ba la skyon du mi bzung zhing 'khu 'phrig mi bya bar/ slar dran pa'i stobs bskyed de shes pa gting grims la kha lhod pa lta bu zhig bya'o// de ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/

dgang ba yis ni lus dag nas// dug dang rims kyi tsha ba 'phrog /bum pa can gyi rlung bcings na// sgo yi bu ga 'gag par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ steng dang 'og tu 'gro ba'i rlung*// yid kyis kha sbyor du byas te/ de yi rnal 'byor goms pa gang*// de yis brtan pa'i go 'phang thob// ces gsungs pa dang mthun la/ yang na dpal nā ro pas/ rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// 'phangs par bya dang rnam pa bzhi// sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba'i nyen// zhes sogs kyis bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan du gsungs pa yang brten na yang legs mod/ spro zhing nus na de'i tshul chos drug gi khrid yig dag las shes par bya'o// de ltar 'bad pas rab tu 'dul bar dka' ba'i sems zhes brjod pa de ni rlung las gud du mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ rlung gi 'pho ba zad pas sems yul la 'phyan pa'i rnam par rtog pa'ang zad par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// de la gong du rlung gi rgyu ba zad par gsungs pa dang*/ 'dir rlung gi 'pho ba zad par gsungs pa gnyis kyi khyad par ji ltar 'byed snyam na/ rlung gi rgyu ba zad pa ni phyi rol tu rlung ma rgyus pas de la brten pa'i sems yul la mi 'phyan/ des phyir chad kyi 'char sgo zad pa dang*/ 'pho ba zad pa ni nang ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phro 'du'ang dmigs med du thim pas/ phyi nang gnyis 'dzin gyi 'pho ba zad pa 'di dngos ni 'phags pa'i dbang du byas pa yin yang*/ rjes mthun pa tsam zhig zhi gnas kyi skabs su'ang 'byung ba yin no// don du zad pa zhes pa med par song ba lta bu ma yin te/ 'gag med kyi rtsal sus kyang mi 'gog pas/ thog ma nas tha ma'i bar du rang bzhin gyis gnas pa yin no// 'o na gang zhe na/ gnas 'gyu'am gshis gdangs kyi rnam dbye rang bzhin shes pa'i dbyings su rdzogs pa la zad pa'i brda sbyar ba tsam mo// 'on kyang skabs 'dir ni rlung la brten pa'ang gnas cha rnyed pa'i ched du yin pa'i phyir/

phal cher gyis bum can chen po 'byongs pa la sogs pa tsam du 'bad pa shas chung yang*/ dbang rnon 'ga' zhig skabs 'di kho nar bum can 'byongs shing lam rdzogs pas shes sgrib dang nyon sgrib dag pa sogs kyi yon tan skye ba'ang srid pa yin no// yang sems rtog pa'i 'khor lo ma zad pa'i rlung gi rnal 'byor gyis ni don gang yang mi 'grub cing ngo mtshar mi che ste/ rgya gar na nya pa dang mu tig bsad pas 'tsho ba dag kyang rlung 'dzin par byed la/ 'jam dbyangs bud+dhas/ rlung sems dbyer med mi skyong ba'i// rlung rkyang 'bud pa skyi ser te// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gar mkhan 'dra// zhes gsungs pa ltar du zad la/ rlung dang mi rtog pa zung 'jug tu bsgom pa ni yang dag pa'i nyams len yin te/ rje sgom tshul gyis/ rlung sems dbyer med man ngag 'di// sgom chen rab kyi nyams len yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o// de ltar sems glang po che ma dul ba 'dra ba 'di nyid/ rde'u shing bu nas 'di'i bar gyi dmigs pa ka ba brtan po dang 'dra ba la/ dran pa thag pa lta bus dam du bcings shing*/ de la sdod du ma btub na shes bzhin lcags kyu lta bus gtsags nas rim gyis rang dbang du byed pa ni/ dbu ma snying po las/ yid kyi glang po log 'gro ba// dmigs pa'i ka ba brtan po la// dran pa'i thag pas legs bcings nas// shes rab lcags kyus rim dbang bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// de yang dran shes gnyis las dran pas ni sems dmigs pa las mi yengs par byed cing*// shes bzhin gyis yengs ma yengs dang bying rgod byung ma byung gi bya ra tsam byed pa'o// 'di'i skabs su dpyod ldan dag /de lta bu'i dran shes kyis yid dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu bzung ba'i tshe/ dmigs pa la gnas mi gnas dang bying rgod byung ma byung brtag pa'i rtog pa phra mo de bskyed na ni mi rtog par mi 'gyur la/

ma bskyed na ni bying rgod sogs rtogs pa'i shes bzhin mi 'byung bas ci ltar bya snyam na/ sgom pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pa dag /de la skyon du bzung nas shes bzhin gyi gsal ngar ni med la/ sems kyi gsal cha ci rigs ni yod pa'i gnas cha skyong bar snang yang*/ de lta bu'i rtog pa phra mo de 'khrul rtog rang mtshan pa ma yin zhing*/ lhag mthong dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes bzhin yin pas bskyed dgos te/ sgom rim bar pa las/ de la nye bar bzhag nas sems la 'di ltar dpyad par bya ste/ ci dmigs pa la sems legs par 'dzin nam/ 'on te bying ngam/ 'on te phyi rol gyi yul la rnam par 'phyar bas rnam par yengs sam snyam du brtag par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de lta bu'i rtog pa phra mo de bskyed lugs kyang ma yengs pa'i dran 'dun btang nas bskyed pa min gyi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang ma shor ba'i thog nas bya ra tsam byed pa'o// rtog pa 'di yang shugs che drags na dran pa shor ba'i rtog pa skyon can ldang nyen yod pas/ snga ma snga ma'i nges shes kyi shugs ma zad tsam la phyi ma phyi mas bya ra tsam byed pa ste/ tshul 'di ni bsam gtan skyong tshul mtha' dag gi gnad dam pa'o// gnyis pa rten med kyi sgom rim ni/ de yang sngar bshad pa'i rde'u shing bu sku gsung thugs rten rlung rnams la brten nas sems 'dzin sgrub pa lta bu ma yin par gang la'ang sems rten bcas pa med pas na rten med ces bya/ 'di la kun mkhyen chen po'i khrid zin du/ thol skyes rbad gcod dang*/ gang shar bzo med dang*/ bzhag thabs kyi gnad rnam pa bzhi tsam las ma gsungs mod/ 'on kyang dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis legs bshad zla ba'i 'od zer du rten med dam gtad med la sbyor ba'i tshul gsungs pa dang mthun par/ grub dbang shākya shrī dz+nyā na'i zhabs kyis rten med gnas 'gyur logs su phye ste khrid pa'i gsungs rgyun bzhin/

bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang phal cher la khrid par mdzad srol ltar smos na/ rten med gnas 'gyu/ thol skyes rbad gcod/ gang shar bzo med/ bzhag thabs kyi gnad rnams bstan pa dang bzhi las/ dang po rten med gnas 'gyu bsgom tshul ni/ lus gnad sogs gzhan thams cad sngar ltar byas nas/ phyi'i dmigs rten dang nang gi dbugs 'gro 'ong sogs la sems gtad de 'dzin ba'i sbyor ba mi byed par/ mig rten med par snang stong sang nge ba la bab kyis blta/ sems dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad de gtad med ma bcos rang gshis su bzhag de'i tshe sems gzhan du mi 'phro bar bde cham mer gnas na gnas tshul de ngo shes tsam byas te 'jog mi gnas par sna tshogs su 'phro zhing 'gyu na 'gyu ba de yang ngo shes tsam byas te 'jog de las gzhan du gnas pa zhig e 'ong gi re ba dang*/ 'gyu ba de ma byung na snyam pa'i dogs pa sogs bsam blo mang po mi gtong bar rang lugs su bzhag ste bsgom par bya'o// 'di ni gsang 'dus las/ sems ni sems min byas nas su// ci yang bsam par mi bya'o// zhes dang*/ gong ma'i gsung las/ rten med ma bcos pa la bzhag /zhes so// 'di skabs gnas 'gyu rig gsum gyi ngos 'dzin cung zhig smra ste/ sems yul thog tu mi 'gro bar sdod pa la gnas pa zer/ mi sdod par yul thog tu 'gro ba la 'gyu ba zer/ de gnyis ngo shes bya lta bu yin/ gnas na gnas par ngo shes mkhan dang 'gyu na 'gyu bar ngo shes mkhan 'di la rig pa zer/ 'di ngo shes byed lta bu'o// de gsum las rig pa gtso che ste/ rig pa 'di ma yengs pa'i ring la nyams len yod la/ rig pa 'di yengs pa'i mod la nyams len rtsa ba nas med pa 'gro ba yin/ ji ltar snyam na/ rang re las dang po pa'i rigs rnams thog mar gnas 'gyu ngo shes tsam yod kyang*/ de'i 'phro bskyang ma shes na/ ci zhig nas rig pa'i gsal ngar nyams te gnas pa'ang ngos mi zin cing 'gyu ba yang ngos mi zin par 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du shar nas yengs 'byams su 'gro ste/

de ni 'jig rten rgan po sos dal la dga' ba zhig bsam blo mang po gtong nas rang gar bsdad pa dang 'dra'o// de dus lus cog ger 'dug kyang don med stong 'dug yin/ mig gi lta stangs hu rer bltas kyang don med stong lta yin/ sems skyong khul byed kyang don med 'khrul 'byams yin pas bsgom don rtsa ba nas stor ba yin no// yang na de bas skyon che ba zhig kyang 'byung nye ste/ ji ltar snyam na/ dang po gnas 'gyu ngo shes tsam yod kyang skyong ma shes pa'i dbang gis bying rmugs 'phel/ de nas yang bying rmugs je 'phel du song nas mig yul gyi gzugs phra rags phal cher mi gsal bar wal po lta bur song*/ de yang je mi gsal du song nas ci zhig na mig gi shes pa thim pas gzugs kyi snang ba 'gag de bzhin du rna ba'i yul sgra la sogs pa'ang mi gsal du song nas mthar 'gags te snang ba med pa dper na dran med brgyal ba lta bu 'byung*/ de la zhi lkugs ltengs po zer te/ rje mi las/ lus gnad mnyam par bzhag dus su// rtog med snang ba 'gags pa de// zhig gnas ltengs po bya ba yin// zhes dang*/ rje dwags pos/ mi rtog ltengs po sgom gyi bdud// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang na de bas cung zad dwangs shing dran pa yud de ba tsam yod pas gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i snang ba ma 'gag kyang*/ shes bzhin gyi gsal ngar med pas gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i snang ba wal por 'gro ba yang 'byung ste/ 'di la zhi gnas 'thoms po zer ba'o// de dag ni nyon mongs pa gti mug gi rigs dang de'i nye nyon gyi char gtogs su gsungs pas na dud 'gror skye ba'i rgyu ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ rmongs pas phal cher dud 'gror 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sa paṇa gyis/ blun pos phyag rgya che sgom pa// phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru 'gyur// zhes so// de dag ni nam du'ang bsgom bar mi bya'o// gnyis pa thol skyes rbad gcod bsgom tshul ni/

de ltar bsgoms pa la yengs shas che ba'i skyon byung ba sel ba'i ched du dran 'dun yengs med kyi rkang 'dzugs pa ste/ lus gnad nya bzhi grims shing sgal tshigs bsrang la mig kyang hu rer blta/ sems gnas kyang snyom me ba ma yin par dran 'dun so bya nya sgug pa ltar grims nas/ thun 'di nyid kyi nang du sems yul gyi rjes su song ba'i rnam par rtog par skye na/ 'phro mthud du mi 'jug par rnam par rtog pa gcig kyang ma skyes par byed dgos snyam pa'i dran pas bzhur nas blta/ de'i tshe dran pa yengs med hrig ge ba de ka'i ngang du gnas na de'i rgyun bskyang*/ de la mi gnas par rnam rtog zhig thol gyis skyes byung na/ de dran 'dun gyis ngos bzung ste rnam rtog de'i mu la 'byams su mi 'jug par/ rnam rtog gang shar de'i 'phro rbad kyis bcad nas dran pa rang thog tu bzhag ste bskyang*/ de yang ngos zin la mi zin la tsam ma yin par legs par ngos bzung nas thun yun thung la thun grangs mang bar byas te bsgom mo/ de ltar thun grangs bsrings kyin bsgoms pas rnam par rtog pa je nyung du mi 'gro bar je mang je rgod du song nas/ mthar rnam rtog gcig gi rting la gcig skye bas rgyun mi chod pa lta bu 'byung bar brten nas/ la la zhig bdag 'dra ba la bsgom gyi skal ba med pa yin nam/ rnam rtog ni sngar bas mang zhing rgod par song snyam pa'i blo sun skye ba sogs 'byung*/ de ni sngar bying rmugs la sogs pa'i dbang du song nas rnam rtog 'phro ba ma tshor ba yin/ 'dir dran rig grung cha bton nas bsgom pas gnas cha cung zad rnyed/ de'i dbang gis rnam rtog 'phro tshad ngos zin pa dper na dgra rkun ngo shes pa lta bu ste/ de yang khang stong zhig tu rkun ma yang yang zhugs kyang bdag po med pas mang nyung gi cha mi 'byung la/ bdag po yod pa'i khang pa'i nang du dgra rkun lan gnyis gsum tsam re 'dzul ba la khang bdag gis tshor nas lan mang du sleb byung zhes gleng zhing dgra rkun ngos 'dzin byed pa dang 'dra bar/

don go rgyu ni/ sngar sems la dran shes kyi bdag po med pas rnam rtog mang du 'gyus kyang ma tshor bas nyung snang 'char ba yin/ 'dir dran shes gsal ngar can gyis bskyangs pas gnas cha cung zad rnyed/ de'i dbang gis 'gyu ba phra rags shar tshad thams cad ngo shes pas rnam rtog mang snang 'char ba ste/ de dus rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor skye ba'i lam stegs lta bur gnas cha'i nyams cung zad rnyed pa'i phyir/ de la gnas pa dang po ri gzar gyi ngos nas chu 'bab pa lta bu zhes bya'o// de yang skad cig ma re re tsam gnas pas rnam rtog gi skye 'gag shes/ de'i dbang gis rnam rtog mang du song ba 'dra zhig byung ba ma gtogs/ rnam rtog rgyun chags su skye bas mang nyung yod pa ma yin te/ rnam rtog skad cig la skye zhing*/ de'i phyi logs kyi skad cig la 'gag pa chos nyid yin pas 'khor ba zo chun gyi 'khyud mo zhes bya/ gnas pa dang po de ni/ til+li pas/ las ni dang po gcong rong 'bab chu 'dra// zhes dang*/ rje zhang gis/ gnas pa dang po byung dus su// ri gzar logs las rbab 'gril 'dra// rnam rtog zam mi chad par ldang*// sgom nyams med dam snyam pa 'ong*// rnam rtog byung tshad tshor ba de// shes pa cung zad gnas pa yin// gnas pa med pa'i gong rol du// rnam rtog rang gar shor ba yin// rtag par 'gyus kyang ngo ma shes// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// de ltar gang zag yengs shas che ba'i rigs dran 'dun yengs med kyi rkang btsugs pa gal che mod// 'od kyang dran pa'i rgyun thag lhod med rang chas su yod pa zhig na 'di la bslab dgos pa'i nges pa'ang med do// kha cig tshul 'di la rnam rtog bkag sgom zhes skyon du brjod kyang skyon du mi 'gyur te blo dang bstun pa'i khrid tshul yin pa'i phyir ro// dper na klu sgrub kyis/ ma he rdzi bo rgas 'khogs shig dgos pa'i dbang gis mgo la ma he'i rwa co skyes par bsgom du bcug pas dgos don grub pa lta bu'o// gsum pa gang shar bzo med kyi bsgom tshul ni/

grims pa'i skyon sel du lus gnad chos bdun ldan lhod cha can du bcas nas/ sems gnad rdzi bo mkhas pas phyugs rgyang 'tsho byed pa ltar 'jog pa ste/ de yang dper na rdzi bo 'tsho skyong gi thabs la mkhas pa des nor phyugs 'tsho ba'i tshe/ nor phyugs rnams rtswa chu yod pa'i phyogs su bzhag nas 'gro 'dug gang byed kyang byed du bcug cing*/ rang nyid ri zur lta bu'i sa snang g.yer che sa zhig tu phyin nas thams cad mi 'og tu tshud par byas shing*/ nor phyugs de rnams g.yang sar 'gro min dang*/ dgra rkun dang 'phar spyang sogs kyi gnod pa byung min lta rtog bgyid de rgyang 'tsho byed pas/ rang nyid dal zhing phyugs ma rnams kyang rtswa chu gang dgar spyad du yod pa dang 'dra bar/ zhi gnas kyi nyams len skyong tshul la'ang*/ rang sems ma yengs tsam gyi dran shes rdzi bo mkhas pa lta bu 'dis/ rnam rtog gi 'gyu cha phra rags phyugs ma dang 'dra ba de dag kho rang 'phro 'du gang byed kyang byed du bcug cing bzhag dran shes kyi rdzi bo rang nyid rnam rtog phyugs ma'i dbang du'ang ma song zhing*/ rnam rtog gi phyugs ma 'phro zhing rgod pa dgag kyang mi dgag par/ dran shes kyi rdzi bos/ bying rgod la sogs pa'i dgra rkun byung min dang*/ zhi lkugs kyi g.yang sar lhung min gyi bya ra byed shes tsam ngang 'dzin pa med par rang babs su bzhag nas bsgoms pas/ rnam par rtog pa 'phror mi nyan par zhi gnas rjes mthun pa tsam gyi ngang la rtse gcig tu gnas pa 'byung*/ de nas yang res 'ga' rnam rtog la sogs par khyur khyur 'gyur 'gro/ de la yang snga ma bzhin kha yan du glod nas bsgoms pas gnas rgyun je gsal je ring du 'gro ba 'ong ste/ do ha las/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni// glod na grol ba the tshom med// zhes so// de dus rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor skye ba'i lam stegs lta bur gnas cha'i nyams 'bring tsam rnyed pa'i phyir/

de la gnas pa bar pa chu klung dal gyis 'bab pa lta bu zhes bya ste/ til+li pas/ bar du chu bo gad+gā dal bzhin g.yo// zhes dang*/ rje zhang gis/ de nas dal 'bab chu bo bzhin// shes pa dal zhing rnam rtog nyung*// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// de lta bu'i gnas nyams bar pa chu klung dal 'bab 'dra ba la'ang dngos dang dngos min gyi shan 'byed cung zad smos na/ dpe chu klung dal 'bab thag ring nas mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis mthong ba dang mtshungs par/ don go rgyu ni/ dran pa'i rgyun ma chad kyang shes bzhin gyi gsal ngar med pa'i rtog med kyi ngang du 'jam nyal le bar gnas shing*/ de'i ngang nas 'gyu ba rags pa shar ba dag ngos zin cing*/ 'gyu ba phra mo phal cher ngos mi zin par 'og 'gyus su shor ba zhig 'byung*/ de ni gnas nyams bar pa chu klung dal 'bab dngos ma yin pas go mi chod la/ dngos ni/ dpe chu klung dal 'bab kyi 'gram du phyin nas bltas pa'i tshe/ rba klong 'khrugs pa rang sar zhi ba'i chu klung dal gyis 'bab lugs chu ris 'char 'jig dang bcas gsal por mthong ba dang mtshungs par/ don go rgyu ni/ dran shes gsal ngar sgrib med kyi ngang nas bab kyis bltas pa na/ sngar gyi rnam rtog ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu de 'dir phra nyal gyis zhi nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i zhi gnas dwangs sing nge ba'i ngang la rtse gcig tu gnas pa 'byung*/ skabs skabs su yul rkyen ci rigs kyi dbang las rnam rtog phra rags gang yang rung ba re gnyis shar ba'ang ngo shes pa'i mod la rtsal rdzogs te gshis thog tu rang yal rjes med du dag pa zhig 'byung na/ de ni gnas nyams bar pa chu klung dal 'bab kyi myong ba dngos 'thon pa yin no// de ltar sems ma bcos lhug par bzhag pa'i gnad 'dis sems kyi dwangs snyigs phyed tshul/ chos rje dwags pos/ sems ma bcos na bde/ chu ma rnyogs na dwangs/ zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po gling ras kyis/

ma bcos so mar bzhag na rtogs pa 'char// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyangs na yongs kyang 'char// dmigs gtad mtshan ma thams cad yongs spongs la// rtag tu mnyam par zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// zhes gsungs/ de ltar thol skyes rbad gcod dang gang shar bzo med kyi bsgom tshul gnyis po rnga mong dang 'dra ste/ de yang dper na/ rnga mong de thag pa'i btags nas brtod na phyogs gzhan du 'gro 'dod bskyed de brtod thag 'then pa sogs byed cing*/ brtod phur las btang na gzhan du mi 'gro bar bag phab ste sdod pa dang mtshungs par/ sngar thol skyes rbad gcod kyi skabs su rnam rtog bkag nas bsgoms pas 'phro rkyen byed la/ 'dir gang shar bzo med kyi skabs na rgya yan du btang bas rnam rtog mi 'phro bar gnas pa go ldog gi tshul can te/ sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis/ bcings par gyur na phyogs bcur 'gro bar rtsom// thongs par gyur na mi g.yo brtan par gnas// go ldog rnga mong lta bur bdag gis rtogs// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// mdor bsdu na/ thol skyes rbad gcod kyis dran 'dun yengs med kyi rkang btsugs nas/ de nas 'dun pa dang gnyis 'dzin a 'thas che ba spang ched gang shar bzo med kyi gnad kyis kun kyang gnyis med rang bzhin yongs shes kyi glod du glod pa yin no// bzhi pa bzhag thabs kyi gnad la'ang*/ bram ze skud pa 'khal ba ltar bzhag pa/ sog phon thag pa chad pa ltar bzhag pa/ bu chung lha khang blta ba ltar bzhag pa/ glang po che la tsher mas btab pa lta bur bzhag pa ste bzhi las/ dang po bram zes skud pa 'khal ba ltar bzhag pa'i tshul ni/ grims lhod ma snyoms pa'i skyon sel du lus gnad chos bdun ldan grims lhod ran par bcas nas/ sems gnad kyang grims lhod ran pa bram zes skud pa 'khal ba lta bur bzhag pa ste/ de yang dper na skye bo dmangs dang mi 'dra bar shes pa gsal zhing gtsang sbra che la las ka la'ang rtsol stobs can gyi bram ze rnams kyis/

rang gi yo byad tshangs skud la sogs pa'i ched du skud pa 'khal ba'i tshe/ grims drags pa'i skyon dang lhod drags pa'i skyon spangs nas snyoms pa zhig byed kyi yod pa ltar/ 'dir zhi gnas bsgom pa'i skabs su'ang dran 'dun grims drags na rtog pa 'chor nas rnal du mi phebs shing*/ dran 'dun lhod drags na snyoms las su lus pa dang*/ lung ma bstan du 'byams pa sogs 'byung bas grims lhod snyoms par bya'o// de la lung ma bstan du 'byams tshul ji ltar snyam na/ thog mar zhi gnas rjes mthun pa tsam skyes par gyur kyang*/ de skyong ma shes pa'i dbang gis bying rmugs 'phel/ de nas yul drug la 'jug pa'i rnam shes drug ka 'gags pa'i zhi lkugs ltengs po dang*/ de bas cung zad dwangs shing dran pa yud de ba tsam dang yul gyi snang ba'am ma 'gag par wal por 'gro ba'i zhi gnas 'thoms po zhes/ gong du nyon mongs pa gti mug gi rigs dang de'i nye nyon gyi char gtogs su bshad zin pa de dag las gsal cha che ba zhig ste/ de yang sems dang yul gyi gsal snang ci rigs dang ldan yang dran pa shugs can gyi khongs nas 'byung ba'i shes bzhin gyis gsal ngar dwangs sang nge ba zhig med pa de la zer/ de ni dge ba'i sems rtse gcig par mi 'gro zhing mi dge ba 'dir 'gyur yang med pas lung ma bstan gyi sems su gtogs so// de bzhin du dran shes mi gsal bar snang ba mtha' dag la dgag sgrub med par gnas pa tsam yang 'du byed btang snyoms pa'i khongs su gtogs dgos pas lung ma bstan gyi sems so// lung ma bstan gyi las ni/ phyis rkyen gyis las gzhan du 'gyur srid kyang 'bras bu mtha' gcig tu mi 'byung bar bshad la/ de dag stabs legs na 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug nyon mongs pa can gyi rgyu'i phyogs su 'gro ba srid kyang*/ de ni bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin skyon med du'ang mi 'gro bas/

'dir bsgrub bya'i bsgom du ni nam yang mi rung ste/ dgongs 'grel las/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ stong pa nyid dang bral ba'i sems// 'gag pa slar yang skye 'gyur te// 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhin// zhes gsungs pas so// de ltar las dang po pa rnams rim gyis bkri ba'i ched du/ dang por thol skyes rbad gcod kyis bsgrims/ de la sun pa dang gang shang bzo med kyis glod/ de lta bu'i res 'jog gis ci zhig na grims lhod rang lugs su snyoms par 'gyur ba la dgongs nas/ 'di la sems sgrim bsgrims nasalhod glod pa bram zes skud pa 'khal ba lta bur bzhag pa zhes bya ste/ sa ra ha zhabs kyis/ bram zes skud pa 'khal ba bzhin// sems grims lhod snyoms pa'i rnal 'byor bde// zhes dang*/ rje phag grus/ gnyug ma chos sku bsgom pa ni// bram zes skud pa 'khal ba bzhin// so ma ma bcos lhug par bzhag /zhes gsungs pa'i don no// gnyis pa sog phon thag pa chad pa ltar bzhag pa'i tshul ni/ sngar gyi dmigs pa bya rtsol spong len gyi spros pas bslad pa'i dran 'dzin de/ 'dir gnas nyams brtan po rnyed pa'i stobs kyis skyur nas rang lugs su bzhag pa ste/ de yang dper na sog phon thag pas bsdams nas khres por byas pa de thag pa chad pa na 'ching byed gzhan med pas rang sar zhig ste 'gro ba ltar/ sngar gyi gnyen po thams cad rnam rtog skyes 'dug pas ma yengs par byed dgos snyam pa sogs bya rtsol spong len gyi spros pas bslad pa'i bzung dran kho na ste/ de dag ni spang bya'i rnam rtog 'gag nas gnyen po dran shes rjes su slob pa tsam las spang gnyen brang 'phrod ma byung bas/ dran pa rnam rtog gi phyis snyeg pa zhes bya ba sgom gyi dri ma yin par gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i dran shes thag pa dang 'dra ba spangs nas zhi gnas kyi rgyun de ka la rang lugs su bzhag pa ni/

sems bya rtsol spong len dang bral bar 'jog pa sog phon thag pa chad pa lta bu zhes bya'o// de ni rtsol med kyi dran pa'i phyogs gtogs tsam ste/ kha sbyor las/ gnyis kyis bzung ba yongs spangs la// rnam rtog gnas dang bral ba ste// nga zhes bya ba'i rnam rtog 'di// de nyid phyir na yongs su spangs// zhes gsungs pa'i don yang yin te/ rgyal ba'i gan mdzod du/ nga zhes pa bzung dran/ de ni bdag lta'i bye brag yin pa la dgongs nas spong bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa bu chung lha khang blta ba ltar bzhag pa'i tshul ni/ snang cha ma 'gag la 'dzin zhen med par bzhag pa ste/ de yang dper na bu chung 'du shes ma bye ba zhig lha khang nang du 'khyer nas bltar bcug pa na/ sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod rdzas kyi bye brag thams cad khra lam mer mthong tsam las 'di yin dang 'di min gyi 'dzin zhen mi skye ba dang 'dra ba/ don go rgyu ni/ sngar phan sems kyi glang po dran shes kyi thag pas dmigs pa'i ka ba la dam por thogs pas rlung rang mal du zin/ de'i dbang gis du ba la sogs pa'i stong gzugs kyis mtshon/ nyams kyi rigs bsam brjod las 'das pa rgya mtsho las rlabs g.yo ba ltar 'char dus nyams byung rgyal du bskyang dgos pa gsungs te/ 'dir gsal nyams dang*/ bde nyams dang*/ stong nyams sam mi rtog pa'i nyams dang gsum du bsdus nas smos na/ dang po gsal nyams ni/ 'byung lnga'i rlung rang mal du 'ching ba las 'char ba dang*/ dbu mar zhugs pa las 'char ba dang*/ dbu mar gnas pa las 'char ba dang*/ dbu mar thim pa las 'char ba sogs yod kyang*/ gang zag phal cher la skabs 'dir 'char ba ni/ dang po gnyis yin te/ de yang sa rlung 'ching ba las du ba lta bu dang*/ chu rlung 'ching ba las smig rgyu lta bu dang*/ me rlung 'ching ba las srin bu me khyer lta bu dang*/ rlung gi rlung 'ching ba las mar me 'bar ba'i phreng ba lta bu'am/

yang na rlung gi rlung 'ching ba las skya rengs gsum pa 'char ba lta bu dang*/ nam mkha'i rlung 'ching ba las nam mkha' sprin dag lta bu ste lnga dang*/ yang sa rlung dbu mar zhugs par rtsom pa'i rtags su thig le ser po 'bar ba'i rnam pa dang*/ chu rlung dbu mar zhugs par rtsom pa'i rtags su yar tshes kyi zla ba'i rnam pa dang*/ me rlung dbu mar zhugs par rtsom pa'i rtags su nyi ma 'char kha'i rnam pa dang*/ rlung gi rlung dbu mar zhugs par rtsom pa'i rtags su sgra gcan gyi rnam pa dang*/ nam mkha'i rlung dbu mar zhugs par rtsom pa'i rtags su glog 'khyug pa'i rnam pa lta bu ste lnga'o// de lta bu'i rtags bcu po rnams gsal ba la dngos su dang mi gsal ba la rmi lam tsam du yang 'byung ste/ rmad byung rgyud las/ du ba smig rgyu me khyer dang*// skya rengs shar ba ji bzhin dang*// nam mkha' sprin dag lta bu 'byung*// zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o// yang rtags bcu shar ba'i rjes su thig le chen po'i snang ba 'char ba'ang yod de/ de yang sad dus sam rmi lam du rang nyid ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal myong ba'am/ gzhan de ltar 'gyur bar mthong ba dang*/ rang nyid bde 'gro gsum gyi longs spyod myong ba'am/ gzhan gyis de ltar myong bar mthong ba sogs 'khor ba na srid tshad kyi rnam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams che chung ma nges pa du ma/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ 'od kor gyi nang du sangs rgyas kyi sku che phra chig rkyang yab yum tshom bu yi ge mchod rten gyi rnam pa sogs go rim nges med du 'char la/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyi rnam pa thams cad kyang 'char bar gsungs te/ dpal sha ba ris/ rtags bcu rtogs par gyur pas na// thig le chen po'i snang ba 'byung*// sna tshogs thig le chen po la// res 'gag nag po'i rnam pa 'byung*// de nas 'gro ba drug sogs dang*// shin tu phra ba'i sprul sku dang*// longs sku du ma mthong gyur pas// sna tshogs gzugs can 'od gsal ba'o// zhes dang*/

nyams sgron las/ gzhan yang rlung zin bag chags dang*// sems phyogs med pa'i rang snang phyir// ngan song gsum gnas sdug bsngal dang*// 'dod khams lha mi'i snang tshul dang*// pad+ma'i tshal dang sangs rgyas zhing*// nyams kyi snang ba ci yang 'char// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gzhan yang mun nag tu bsgoms kyang yul snang kun zla ba shar ba lta bu'i gsal snang gis khyab cing*/ de yun du bskyangs pas khang khyim dang ri rwa ba sogs kyis sgrib pa med par pha rol gyis ci byed mthong ba dang*/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes 'char ba snyam byed pa dang*/ mtshan mo'ang nye ring gi dngos po rnams mthong ba snyam byed pa sogs 'byung ba na/ thos pa chung la rlom pa che ba rnams bdag ni sa lam mthon por sleb bo snyam du khengs sems skye nyen yod do// gnyis pa bde nyams ni/ lus la shin sbyangs kyi bde ba thob pa lta bu dang*/ reg bya bde bar 'char ba dang*/ lus yod med mi tshor ba'i bde ba dang*/ sems dga' spros rgod snying 'dod pa dang*/ blo bde zhing skyid snang 'char ba dang*/ nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa tsam gyi bde bas lus sems gang ba dang*/ 'khrig pa'i bde ba lta bus lus gang zhing brgyal ba tsam dang*/ bde ba khal khol g.yo ba lta bu sogs 'byung ngo*// gsum pa mi rtog pa'i nyams sam stong nyams ni/ rnam rtog gi ra ri gtan nas med pa nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu 'byung ba dang*/ lus sems yod du mi tshor bar bar snang stong pa la 'dug pa lta bu dang*/ yul snang yod pa mi tshor bar bya ba byed rgyu brjod pa dang*/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po thams cad la stong pa'i 'dzin stangs skye ba dang*/ gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i yul snang thams cad bkrag med ban bun du 'char ba dang*/ rang yang med pa lta bu dang*/ snang ba thams cad stong pa'i rnam 'gyur du 'char ba sogs 'byung ngo*// rnam par bzhag tshul gzhan yang*/ lus nyams dang*/ sems nyams dang*/

snang nyams dang*/ rmi nyams bzhir bzhag par mdzad pa dang*/ gzugs kyi rnam pa'i mthong nyams/ sgra'i rnam pas thos nyams/ dri'i rnam pa'i tshor nyams sogs dbang po gzugs can pa lnga'i yul gyi snang ba dang 'dra ba yid yul du'ang 'byung tshul sogs mang yang re zhig de tsam mo// de ltar 'byung tshul rje mi las/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams la ci yang 'char// dbyar ka'i spang la ci yang skye// zhes gsungs/ nyams de dag la chags shing zhen na khams gsum du gol ba'i tshul yang*/ rje mi las/ bde dang gsal dang mi rtog gsum// 'di gsum sgom gyi gol sa yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rje phag grus/ bla ma dam pa'i rtsar phyin te// gdams pa gang rung nyams blangs pas// bde bas lus sems gang ba 'byung*// zhen cing chags pas bskyangs byas pas// 'dod khams gnas su gol nas 'gro// gsal ba dwangs pa mkha' lta bu// phyi nang zla ba shar ba 'dra// phye dang btsum pa khyad par med// de la zhen cing chags pa yis// sgrub pa po yis bskyangs gyur na// gzugs kyi khams su gol bar 'gyur// phyi dang nang du bltas gyur kyang*// rtog pa phra ba tsam yang med// rdul bral chos skur blta byas nas// dga' dang mi dga' bsam pa yis// nyams len nges par bskyangs gyur na/ gzugs med khams su gol bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gling ras kyis/ nyams myong 'ja' tshon dang 'dra ba'i gsal snang la// blo chung byis pa dang 'dra ba'i sgom chen chags// bslu brid gol sa zhig yin te ngo ma shes// zhes gsungs so// des na nyams kyi snang ba ci shar yang dga' ba dang skyon du bltas nas ched du 'dzin pa dang snang cha 'gog pa gang yang mi bya bar/ snang cha zur tsam yang ma 'gag la 'dzin pa dang zhen pa rdul tsam yang med par nyams byung rgyal du bskyangs pa la bu chung lha khang blta ba lta bur bzhag pa zhes bya ste/ bram ze chen pos/ bsam dang bsam bya rab tu spangs nas su// ji ltar bu chung tshul du gnas par bya// zhes dang*/

bsam dang bsam bya thams cad yongs su dor nas su// ji ltar bu chung lhug par gnas pa bzhin// bla ma'i lung la bsgrims te gus 'bad na// lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med// ces gsungs pa'i don no// bzhi pa glang po che la tsher mas btab pa ltar bzhag pa'i tshul ni/ rnam rtog byung tshor la dgag sgrub mi byed par bzhag pa ste/ de yang dper na glang po che ni dud 'gro gzhan las lus stobs che zhing ko ba mthug pas/ de 'gro dus tsher mas btab pa dang*/ ma btab pas dgag sgrub gang yang mi byed pa ltar/ don go rgyu ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i zhi gnas kyi ngang la gnas pa'i rjes thog tu/ rnam par rtog pa phra rags gang yang rung ba skyes pa dang de ngo shes pa'i dran rig dus mnyam du langs nas/ spang bya rnam rtog dang gnyen po dran rig brang 'phrod pas/ rnam rtog gcig nas gnyis su brgyud de 'khrul 'byams su'ang 'gro mi thub cing*/ lung ma bstan phul ma'i zhabs kyi 'jab chu 'dra bar yang mi shor la/ gnyen po dran pa rang yang sngar ltar rtsol bas bsgrub ma dgos par rtsol med du rang byung bas na dran pa tshur bskyangs pa zhes bya'o// spang gnyen brang 'phrod pa 'di la/ rdzogs chen bi ma snying thig brgyud pa'i man ngag rnams las/ dang po rnam rtog ngo shes pas grol ba sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lta bu zhes gsungs so// de ltar rnam rtog byung ba tshor dus 'phro ba dgag pa dang gnas pa sgrub pa'i blang dor mi byed par/ 'phro gnas khyad med du 'jog pa ni glang po che la tsher mas btab pa lta bur bzhag pa'i don no// de la gnas pa mtha' ma rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu zhes kyang gsungs te/ rje zhang gis/ de nas rgya mtsho'i gting bzhin du// shes pa mi g.yo brtan par gnas// zhes dang*/ pra khrid las/ mi rtog thig le'i ngang la gnas pa ni// mi bskyod dwangs ma'i rgya mtsho chen po'i ngang*// mi g.yo gsal ba til gyi mar me 'dra// zhes so// gnas nyams mtha' ma rgya mtsho rlabs bral lta bu de la'ang dngos dang dngos min gyi shan 'byed cung zad smos na/

dper na dbyar dus kyi rgya mtsho rlabs bral zhig mtshan mo'i zla snang la mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis mthong ba dang*/ ston dus kyi rgya mtsho rlabs bral zhig nyin snang la gsal por mthong ba'i tshul gnyis kyi khyad par bzhin/ don go rgyu ni/ sems bying skyon phra ba ma sangs pa'i zhi gnas 'thoms po dang lung ma bstan gyi ngang la gnas pa ni dngos ma yin pas go mi chod la/ de 'dra'i bying skyon phra mo'ang sangs nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i zhi gnas gsal zhing dwangs la rig cha dang bcas pa zhig gi ngang du gnas cha rnyed na/ de ni gnas nyams mtha' ma rgya mtsho rlabs bral dngos kyi myong ba 'thon pa yin no// de la mtha' ma zer ba'i don yang 'dod sems rtse gcig pa'i myong ba mthar thug pa la dgongs pa'o// zhes gan mdzod las bshad do// zhi gnas kyi rnam par bzhag 'jog gzhan yang*/ mdo sde rgyan dang mngon pa kun btus sogs las sems gnas pa rnam pa dgus gnas par gsungs pa rnams/ 'dir sbyor ba'i tshul yang zur tsam smos na/ de yang dang po sems 'jog pa dang gnyis pa rgyun du 'jog pa ste gnyis po 'dir dben gsum rten can rnams dang sbyor la/ gsum pa blan te 'jog pa dang bzhi pa nye bar 'jog pa ste gnyis po 'dir thol skyes rbad gcod dang sbyor la/ lnga pa dul bar byed pa dang drug pa zhi bar byed pa dang bdun pa rnam par zhi bar byed pa ste gsum po 'dir spyir bstan nam spyi khyab tu 'gyur la/ brgyad pa rtse gcig tu byed pa ni 'dir gang shar bzo med kyi skyong tshul dang sbyor la/ dgu pa mnyam par 'jog pa ni bzhag thabs gnyis pa man dang sbyor tshul yang gan mdzod las so// gzhan yang legs bshad zla 'od las/ stobs drug gis 'grub tshul dang*/ de la yid la byed pa bzhi yod tshul gsungs pa rnams 'dir 'chad na mang gis dogs so// 'di skabs mdo lam gyi sgom rim gtso bor ston pa'i mkhas pa kha cig gis/

smos ma thag pa'i sems gnas dgu pa rgyud la skyes kyang lus sems la shin sbyangs ma thob na/ de la 'dod sems rtse gcig pa dang zhi gnas dang rjes su mthun pa'i yid la byed pa zhes zer/ sems gnas dgu pa rgyud la skyes shing lus sems la shin sbyangs thob pa zhig na/ de ni bsam gtan bzhi gang rung yin zhing zhi gnas mtshan nyid par yang 'dogs tshul dang*/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu po bsgom dgos tshul skad gsangs mthon pos bshad kyang*/ 'dir sngags lam gyi sgom rim gtso bor ston pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams ni/ mthar gnas dgu la mi bltos par 'dod sems rtse gcig pa dang bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs gang yang rung ba'i steng nas spros bral du na spar te zhi lhag zung 'jug gi lam bsgom du rung bar bzhed la/ de ni slob dpon dpa' bos/ khyod kyi chos la mi phyogs pa'i// skye bo ma rig gis ldongs pa// srid rtse'i bar du phyin nas kyang*// sdug bsngal yang 'byung srid pa sgrub// khyod kyi bstan pa'i rjes zhugs rnams// bsam gtan dngos gzhi ma thob kyang*// bdud kyis mig ras btsa' bzhin du// srid pa dag ni bzlog par byed// ces gsungs pa dang 'dra'o// de dus bying rgod rmongs gsum gyi skyon dang bral zhing bde gsal mi rtog pa'i gdangs dang ldan pa'i zhi gnas kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ gnas cha ma yengs pa'i thog nas 'gyu ba bun tsam skyes pa rang ngo shes ma thag rang sar grol ba la gnas thog tu 'gyu ba'i rang ngo shes pa zhes bya/ 'gyu cha bun tsam las gcig nas gnyis su 'gyu ba mu mthud du mi 'gro bar/ de ma thag gnas pa'i rang sa 'dzin pa la 'gyu thog tu gnas pa'i rang sa zin pa zhes bya/ de nas gnas 'gyu gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bar la de yang rig thog tu zhig pa na gnas 'gyu bar lag 'gyel ba zhes bya ste/ de dus rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor rang ngo 'phrod pa yin no// de dag gi tshe/

gnas pa dang 'gyu ba ngo shes mkhan de la dran pa'am/ shes bzhin nam/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'am/ chos rab rnam 'byed dam/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab bam/ skabs 'di nyid du rang rig pa zhes kyang bya ste/ de'ang mdo sde rgyan las/ des na de yi lus dang sems// shin tu sbyangs pa che thob nas// yid la byed rang bcas shes bya// zhes so// de lta bu'i rtse gcig gi skabs su mnyam bzhag de'i ngor nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog rang mtshan pa mi dmigs pa'i cha nas spros bral dang khyad med kyang*/ de nyid la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i spros pa ma spangs pa'i cha nas spros bral las dman pa yin tshul sogs nyams myong gi spu ris 'byed thabs mang yang gzhan las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba dpyad de lhag mthong ngos bzung nas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i skabs 'dir dpyad sgom mang du 'byung ba la/ kha cig na re/ chu dwangs su 'dod nas dbyug pas dkrugs pa lta bu'i dpyad par ci byed/ chu ma rnyogs na dwangs shing gzugs brnyan 'char ba dang 'dra bar sems rang lugs su bzhag na ye shes 'char ba'i phyir zer/ de ni dbang rnon cig car ba'i lam thad drang du ston pa'i zur skad zhig ste/ 'dir dbang rtul rim gyis bkri ba'i tshe/ sngar rtse gcig gi dus na rgyud la skyes pa'i zhi gnas kyi nyams de bshig nas spros bral du na spar ba'i ched du dpyad sgom gsungs pa yin te/ gu ru rin po ches/ phu chu drag po brdab kyin bzang*// rnal 'byor sgom pa bshig gin bzang*// zhes dang*/ rje 'brug pas/ sgom shes mang ste bshig shes nyung*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de la spyi skad du/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i dpyad sgom dang ku su lu'i 'jog sgom zhes gtso che chung gis bzhag kyang*/ don du paṇ+ḍi ta la'ang bsgom bya'i don la mnyam par bzhag pa'i 'jog sgom dgos shing*/ ku su lu pa la'ang lta ba la sgro skur gcod pa'i dpyad sgom dgos la/

de med na dpyad gzhig kho nas btsal ba'i lta ba de blos byas kyi lta bar 'gyur la/ bzhag pa kho na'i lta ba de'ang sems kyi nyams myong tsam du 'gyur bas/ gcig kho nas yang dag pa'i lta sgom rnyed par dka'o// 'o na paṇ+ḍi ta'i dpyad tshul dang ku su lu pa'i dpyad tshul gyi khyad par ji ltar 'byed snyam na/ kha phyir ltas kyi shes pas rjes dpag lam byed kyi sgo nas lta sgom gyi sgro skur gcod pa de la pan+ḍi ta'i dpyad pa zer/ kha nang ltas kyi rig pas mngon sum lam byed kyi sgo nas lta sgom gyi sgro skur gcod pa de la ku su lu pa'i dpyad pa zer ro// de las dang po de lam bul zhing phyi ma 'di lam myur ba yin te/ rje rgod tshang pas/ mtha'i skyel so la khyad par med kyang*/ lam ni ku su lu'i 'di myur ba yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na 'dir dpyad pa'i tshul gsungs pa thams cad ku su lu pa'i dpyad sgom du nges par byas nas dkyus don 'chad pa la/ gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba dpyad pa dang*/ lhag mthong ngos bzung ba dang*/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa ste gsum las/ dang po gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba bcad pa'i tshul ni/ skyabs sems bla ma'i rnam 'byor sogs sngon du btang nas thugs yid bsres te mnyam par bzhag de nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i zhi gnas kyi gsal ngar so sor rtog pa'i shes rab tu langs pa des/ gnas na gnas pa'i ngo bo ji lta bu zhig 'dug tshul ji ltar gnas/ gnas pa de las ji ltar 'gyu/ 'gyu ba'i tshe gnas pa las g.yel te gnas pa med par 'gyu'am/ yang na rang ngo gnas bzhin par 'gyu/ 'gyu ba'i tshe gnas pa e 'dug 'gyu ba de gnas pa las gzhan pa zhig yin nam min/ 'gyu ba de ka'i ngo bo ngos bzung ji lta bu zhig 'dug mthar 'gyu cha 'gag pa'i tshul ji 'dra zhes dpyad/ de'i tshe 'gyu dus gnas mkhan dang*/ gnas dus 'gyu mkhan sogs 'dug snyam na/ 'o na de gnyis sdod dus steng 'og gam/

mnyam gshibs sogs ci 'dra byas nas bsdad 'dug blta/ 'gro dus gcig 'gro gcig 'dug gam/ mnyam 'gro mnyam 'dug ji ltar byed blta/ yang gnas dus 'gyu ba min 'dug cing*/ 'gyu dus kyang gnas pa min 'dug pas de gnyis gcig go snyam na/ de yang gcig lugs la brtag par bya ste/ 'gyu cha'i rnam rtog med dus gcig par 'dug gam/ yod dus gcig par 'dug med dus gcig par 'dug snyam na/ khong gnyis 'dres pa'i tshul du gcig par 'dug gam sogs dpyad/ rnam rtog yod dus gcig par 'dug snyam na/ 'gyu ba gnas par phar gcig gam/ gnas pa 'gyu bar tshur gcig sogs dpyad pas/ mthar gnas 'gyu gnyis ka'i ngo bo ngos bzung med par go zhing*/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du rig pas de dag la gnyis 'dzin dang dgag sgrub mi byed par gnas na gnas thog dang 'gyu na 'gyu thog tu bzhag pas rang shar rang grol du nges pa rnyed/ de ltar gnas pa las gzhan du 'gyu ba dang*/ 'gyu ba las gzhan du gnas pa zhig bzhag tu med par shes na/ gnas rgyu'i ngo bo ma rnyed pa de'i tshe/ yang dpyad pa'i tshul kha spos te/ lta mkhan gyi rig pa 'di nyid/ blta bya'i gnas 'gyu las gzhan du'am/ gnas 'gyu dang gcig pa gang yin zhes/ kha nang du log tsam byas te rang rig pa'i mig gis brtag cing dpyad pas/ dpyod mkhan rang yang gnas 'gyu las logs su ngos bzung rgyu ci yang ma rnyed pas/ de'i tshe blta bya dang lta byed dbyer med pa'i shes pa gsal stong rang rig rang gsal tsam zhig nyams su myong ba 'byung*/ de dus sems tsam pa'i lta ba nyams 'og tu chud pa yin tshul/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos nges don lta ba'i mig tu/ rtse gcig gi dus su sems tsam pa'i lta ba rdzogs pa yin te/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ shes pa rig cing gsal ba dang*/ de'i nyams bde bar shar ba ste bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum rtse gcig tu gnas pa yin// zhes dang*/

yang rje des rgyal ba'i gan mdzod du/ de bas bla ma rnams sems tsam pa dang cha mthun khyad 'phags zhes pa'i cha mthun brtsi sa 'dir yin/ dngos ni ma yin te/ rtog tshul khyer bas ma lcogs nas sems tsam du lus pa ma gtogs zhe 'dod du mi byed/ ces dang*/ so skye la 'od gsal 'char kar 'di lta bu nges par 'byung bas/ laṅkar gshegs pa dang*/ byams pa'i rgyan gnyis dang*/ ka ma la shrī la'i sgom rim rnams su'ang*/ sbyor lam du sems tsam pa'i lta ba ston pa'i gnad der 'dug go /zhes gsungs so// de dus kyi lta ba'i ngo bo ni 'di dang 'di lta bu zhig go snyam du blos gang du'ang bzhag tu ma rnyed cing khas len mi nus pa'i phyir/ de la blo 'das kyi lta ba'am lta ba khas len dang bral ba zhes kyang bya ste/ dpal rgyal ba'i dbang pos/ blos byas kyi lta ba bzang yang 'jig /blo 'das la lta ba'i ming yang med// blta bya dang lta byed dbyer med pa'i// nges pa de bla ma'i drin las rnyed// ces gsungs/ de'i nges pa rnyed tshul kyang gan mdzod du/ 'di'i nges pa'ang nges shes 'drongs zhes pa lta bu ma yin par/ mthong ba'i lam la nges par bzhag pa de'o// zhes bkral bar mdzad/ tshul de lta bu'i dpyad pa de ka slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ ci nas ting 'dzin brtson pa ni// skad cig gcig kyang mi 'chor ba// bdag gi yid ni gar dpyod ces// de ltar yid la so sor brtag /ces gsungs so// de yang dper mtshon na/ shing zhun po phyed du gshags pa gnyis phan tshun drud cing bsrubs pa las blo bur du me byung*/ des shing gnyis bsreg nas thal bar byas rjes/ sreg byed kyi me rang yang zad pa dang mtshungs par/ gnas 'gyu gnyis po la so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab tu yangs/ des gnas 'gyu rang bzhin med par sbyangs pa'i mthar/ shes rab kho rang yang dmigs pa med pa'i ngang du zhi tshul/
