bud shing dang me'i dpes 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdor gsungs te/ shing gnyis drud pa las ni me 'byung ste// byung ba de yis de gnyis sreg pa ltar// de bzhin shes rab dbang po skyes nas kyang*// skyes pa de yis de gnyis sreg par byed// ces so// gnyis pa lhag mthong ngos bzung ba la/ spyir zhi rags kyi rnam pa can 'jig rten pa'i lam la grags pa'i lhag mthong dang*/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa can theg dman gyi lam la grags pa'i lhag mthong dang*/ bdag med rnam pa gnyis rtogs byed theg chen gyi lam la grags pa'i lhag mthong ste gsum las/ 'dir phyi ma ste/ 'di la'ang mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel dang mngon ba kun btus sogs las rnam dbye mang nyung dang*/ dkon mchog sprin dang dus 'khor sogs mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa de dag las rtog bcas dang rtog med la ngos 'dzin tshul sna tshogs byung bar brten/ sa dge bka' rnying gi mkhas grub rnams kyi bzhed tshul la'ang khyad par cung zad re snang zhing*/ de las dkon mchog sprin dang mdo sde rgyan sogs mdo'i dgongs pa gtso bor bton nas so sor rtog pa kho na la lhag mthong du ngos 'dzin mdzad pa dag gis/ shes pa rtog med la lhag mthong du 'dod pa dag ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab spangs pa'i phyir ha shang yin/ zhes chos dang gang zag la smad pa'i gtam ri bong gi chal sgra ltar sgrog pas/ brtag dpyad kyi rnam dbye mi shes pa'i skye bo phal cher rig dwags kyi tshogs ltar chos spong gi ku co 'don par byed cing*/ dus 'khor sogs gsar ma'i rgyud dang*/ seṅge rtsal rdzogs sogs rnying ma'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa gtso bor bton nas rtog bral 'dzin med kyi shes pa kho na la lhag mthong du ngos 'dzin mdzad pa dag gis/ gcig shos la rtog dpyod kho na la blo gtad bcol ba'i rtog ge ba zhes brnyas pa sogs chos min gyi las ngan gsog pa mang du mthong mod/

'on kyang bka' brgyud rang lugs ni/ lhag mthong gi sbyor ba brten pa'i skabs su so sor rtog pa la lhag mthong zhes btags kyang*/ dngos gzhi'i skabs na rtog bral 'dzin med kyi shes pa stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can de la lhag mthong du bzhed pa yin te/ rje mar pa'i spyan sngar mi las rtogs pa 'bul ba'i gsung 'gros las/ mdor na zhi gnas bzang po'i nyams ngar 'don dang bcas pa 'di dang*/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab zab mos dpyod pa dang bcas pa 'di/ lhag mthong thob par byed pa'i thabs med du mi rung ba skas la 'dzeg pa'i skas them 'og ma dang 'dra bar bsam lags/ zhes byung ba'i phyir dang*/ de bzhin du kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i rgyal ba'i gan mdzod las kyang*/ zhi gnas de ka'i ngo bo tshul bzhin yid la byed pa la so sor rtog pa zhes bya la/ de ka bzhin kā ma la shī la'i sgom rim gsum du yang*/ mtshan ma med pa'i zhi gnas de ka so sor rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan du langs par bshad pas/ lhag mthong mtshan nyid pa ma yin yang*/ rang sa der chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa de yin pas/ shes bzhin de ka la so skye'i skabs 'dir lhag mthong du bzhag nas// zhes dang*/ des na de dag gi lhag mthong yang phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa las ldog pa tsam yin gyi/ phyin ci log thams cad drungs 'byin gyi gnyen po ma yin pas na/ lhag mthong mtshan nyid par rje gong ma rnams mi bzhed/ de'i phyir lhag mthong gi ngo bo ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can de la zer ba yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de na phyogs gnyis ka'i nyes par 'jug pa'i go skabs med pa zhig ste/ de lta'i tshul la dgag bzhag spang gsum gyi rnam bzhag mdzad tshul sogs ni 'dir spro bya ma yin no// de ltar rnam dbye bzhag 'jog mang yang don la gsum du 'du ste dmigs pa'i lhag mthong dang*/ nyams dus kyi lhag mthong dang*/

rtogs pa'i lhag mthong ngo*// de yang gnyis su 'du ste lam dus kyi lhag mthong dang 'bras bu'i lhag mthong ngo*/ dang po lam dus kyi lhag mthong ngos 'dzin pa'i tshul ni/ rang gi sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rtsal gsal la go ma 'gag pa de la lhag mthong zhes bya ste/ de'i don la 'jog tshul ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas bla ma nyid sangs rgyas kun 'dus su shes pa'i blos gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas dbang bzhi blangs shing 'od du zhu te rang la bstims pas/ bla ma'i dgongs brgyud rtogs pa'i byin rlabs rang rgyud la 'phos nas sems nyid rig stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su lhag ger 'char ba 'byung*/ de'i rang rtsal rig cha rtog bral 'dzin med kyi shes pa de la lhag mthong zhes bya ste/ ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ zhi gnas ni rtse gcig pa'o// lhag mthong ni rig pa'o// zhes dang*/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos don dam mdzub tshugs mar/ spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings su gnas pa la zhi gnas dang*/ de'i rtsal gsal rig gi cha la lhag mthong du bzhag ces gsungs pas so// de'i tshe las dang po pa'i gang zag rnams de ka'i ngang du yun ring mi gnas pas/ lhag mthong gi shes rab 'di las rol pa spyir rnam rtog dang sgos nyon mongs pa'i 'gyu ba ji lta bu zhig skyes kyang*/ de dag spong yang mi spong la/ de'i dbang du'ang mi gtong bar/ skye ba'i skad cig de gar rang ngo rang shes tsam ngang bzo med du bzhag pas/ spong len dgag sgrub ci'ang ma dgos par/ rnam rtog dang nyon mongs pa gang shar ci 'gyus thams cad ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i stong nyid du 'char zhing*/ de yang rtog pa'i rnam pa grwa ma chag cing gru ma nyams par gsal ba dang*/ ngo bo ngos bzung med pa'i stong pa gnyis po dbyer mi phyed par/ 'gyu ba stong pa'i rang bzhin can dang*/ stong pa 'gyu pa'i rnam 'gyur can du nyams su myong bas/

a 'thas kyi bden 'dzin mi bskyed pa de ni rnam rtog lhan skyes kyi rang ngo mthong ba ste/ rje sgom tshul gyis/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rlabs// de phyir gshis gdangs dbyer med lhan cig skyes// zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams 'og tu chud pa'o// 'di'i skabs su rtog pa'i 'char sgo ma 'gag pa la zhen 'dzin rang sar dag pa de zhi gnas dang*/ de nyid kyang skye med chos sku stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du rang ngo shes pa'i cha de lhag mthong ste/ de lta bu'i 'gyur stong dbyer med de la zhi lhag zung 'jug ces bya'o// de la bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis rnam rtog chos skur grol ba'i tha snyad btags pa'i tshul la/ mkhas pa kha cig gis klan kar mdzad kyang*/ de la sgam po pa bkra shis rnam rgyal dang rgyal dbang pad+ma dkar po sogs kyis rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i mgo snyoms kyi rigs pas rtsod spong mdzad tshul yang 'dir smos na mang gis dogs so// rnam rtog chos sku'i 'dod tshul la'ang kha cig gis/ rnam rtog la bltas pas de nyid dag nas mi rtog par cham gyis 'gro ba la zer ba dang*/ kha cig gis/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin rtogs na chos sku dang ma rtogs na chos sku min par bshad pa dang*/ la las/ gnas tshul la chos sku dang snang tshul la rnam rtog tu bzhed pa sogs snang yang*/ rang lugs ni gong du smos pa ltar yin no// rnam rtog lam du 'khyer tshul des rigs 'gres nas rkyen bzang ngan thams cad lam du 'khyer nus pas na rkyen lam du slong pa yang zer/ rnam par rtog pa nyid rang ngo rang gis shes pa tsam gyis rang grol du 'gro bas na spang gnyen dbyer med du gyur pa zhes kyang bya ste/ 'di la rdzogs chen bi ma snying thig brgyud pa'i man ngag rnams las ni/ bar du rnam rtog kho rang gis ngo shes nas grol ba sbrul gyi mdud pa zhig pa lta bu zhes gsungs/

de ltar spang gnyen dbyer med du rtogs pa 'di ni rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gyi snying po bzlog pa'i sgom pa zhes kyang bya'o// de yang spyi la grags pa/ bzlog pa'i sgom pa 'di nyid ni// sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes// zhes bskyed rim man chad kyis mi shes pa'i gsang ba zab par bsngags pa'i bzlog sgom dngos ni 'di min te/ de ni chos rdze ras pas/ rtog pa'i gnyen por rtog pa thong*// bzlog bsgom rtog pa'i skor 'ded yin// zhes spang gnyen can du gsungs pa de'o// 'dir ni spang bya dang gnyen po sogs gnyis chos thams cad dang bral ba zhig yin pas/ spang gnyen can de las kyang khyad par du 'phags pa zhig go /'on kyang ming de ltar 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ thog mar spang gnyen can de la goms pas kyang*/ ci zhig na spang gnyen dbyer med 'di 'byung ba'i phyir/ rgyu ming 'bras bu la btags nas de skad du gsungs pa'o// gnyis pa 'bras bu'i lhag mthong ngos 'dzin pa'i tshul ni/ gshis 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba chen po/ gdangs skye dgag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ kun kyang zung 'jug klong yangs chen por ro gcig pa zhig go /de yang go bde bar byas te smos na/ gshis 'gyur med bde chen ni/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku ste dper mtshon na rgya mtsho lta bu'o// gdangs skye dgag gnas bral las rtsal gdangs gnyis su phye nas/ rtsal rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa ni/ chos sku'i rang rtsal te dper na rgya mtsho'i rlabs lta bu'o// gdangs snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ni/ chos sku'i rang gdangs te dper na rgya mtsho la gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba lta bu yin pas na/ ming gsum du btags kyang don la ye nas so so ma yin tha mi dad pa zhig ste/ rje sgom tshul gyis/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos sku dngos// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rlabs// dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i don// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// de'i don bsdu na/

gshis 'gyur med bde chen ni/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ste gdod nas snang ba dang lhan cig tu skyes pa'i phyir dang*/ gdangs skye dgag gnas bral lam rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ni/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ste gdod nas sems nyid dang lhan cig tu skyes pas so// des na ye nas snang sems dbyer med lhan skyes su gnas tshul dper na nyi ma dang nyi 'od lta bu zhig ste/ rje dwags pos/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// de phyir snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// de'ang bsdu na/ tha mal gyi shes pa rig cha go ma 'gag pa 'di ste/ 'di'i rang ngo ma shes par 'khrul pa la 'khor ba dang*/ rang ngo shes nas grol ba la myang 'das zhes bya/ shes pa kho rang ni 'khor ba na ngan du ma song la/ 'das pa na bzang du ma song bas/ rgya gar yang ma chad cing phyogs gang du'ang ma lhung ba zhig go /de la da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma zhes kyang zer te/ de'ang da lta'i sgras dus gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i da lta ba dang*/ skad cig ma'i sgras mi rtag pa'i khyad chos su bzhag pa'i skad cig ma dag la go rgyu min te/ 'o na ji ltar yin snyam na/ dper na nyi ma ni snga dro nas phyi dro'i bar du shar bzhin pa yin na'ang*/ re zhig sprin gyis bsgribs te ma mthong ba de/ sprin mthongs bye ste mthong ba'i tshe/ da lta nyi ma skad cig tsam shar byung zhes gleng ba dang chos mtshungs par/ tha mal gyi shes pa rig cha ma 'gag pa'ang rang re la dus thams cad du rgyun chad med par shar na'ang*/ rnam rtog snga phyi'i drwa bas bsgribs nas ma mthong ba de/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyi rten 'byung las/ da lta rnam rtog snga phyi so mtshams na tha mal gyi shes pa rig cha go ma 'gag par rig stong lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin lhag ger mthong bas na de skad du btags ba ste/

rje mi las/ rtog pa snga phyi'i so mtshams na// ye shes rgyun du 'char de brod// ces gsungs/ yang na rig pa skad cig ma zhes pa mi 'gyur bas skad cig phyi mar mi 'gro ba'i don te/ dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ dang po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i skad cig gis sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o// de'i don la 'jog tshul ni/ rang re rnams tshe 'di blos btang nas ri'i bu byas shing na bun gyi gos gyon te/ dben pa'i mal du lus gnad skyil krung dang ma bral/ ngag gnad bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i gdung dbyangs dang ma bral/ sems gnad bla ma la chos skur shes pa'i mos gus dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas gsol ba btab cing dbang bzhi blangs mthar thug yid bsres/ de nas gnas lugs tha mal gyi shes pa 'di ma bcos rang gshis su bzhag cing*/ de'i rang rtsal go ma 'gag pa'i rig cha rtog bral 'dzin med des rang ngo shes tsam gyi rgyun yengs bsgom gnyis med du bskyang ba ste/ de ni tog tse bas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi chad// brtag pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// sgom du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang du zhog /ces dang*/ rje mi las/ tha mal shes pa skyong skyong nas// ma rig 'khrul pa brjed de thal// zhes dang*/ rje dwags pos/ tha mal shes pas chog pa'i nyams len 'di// sangs rgyas mi gzugs can gyi drin las rnyed// ces so// de'i tshe rang gshis su gnas pa'i cha de zhi gnas dang*/ rang ngo shes pa'i cha de lhag mthong ste zhi lhag zung 'jug go /de bzhin rang ngo shes pa'i cha la rig pa dang*/ shes bya'i mkhyen cha go ma 'gag pa'i cha la 'gyu ba dang*/ de gnyis tha dad med pa'i cha la gnas pa ste chos nyid rig pa 'od gsal gyi gnas 'gyu rigs gsum zhes kyang bya'o// de ltar gshis skye med la brtan pa ma thob kyi bar du bya ba dgu phrugs su btang nas yengs med bsgom med du bskyang bar bya dgos te/

gsang ba bdud rtsi rgyal po'i rgyud las// bsgom du rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig med pa'o// zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ ltos shig ltos shig ci yang ma lta zhig /sgoms shig sgoms shig ci yang ma sgoms shig /ces pa ltar bya'o// 'di dus kyang ma bsgom par sems rang lugs su 'jog pa zhi gnas dang*/ don thog nas ma yengs pa lhag mthong ste zhi lhag zung 'jug go /'phros su sgra mthun don 'phags kyi gnad cung zad smos na/ gong du zhi gnas kyi skabs su rtog pa snga ma 'gag phyi ma ma shar ba'i bar na shes pa rtog med had de bar gnas pa de dang*/ 'dir lhag mthong gi skabs su rtog pa snga phyi'i so mtshams na tha mal gyi shes pa rig cha go ma 'gag par dwangs seng nger 'char ba gnyis po ma nor bar ngo shes dgos/ de gnyis shan 'byed pa'i gnad bsdu na/ snga ma de drug pa yid shes rtog med dam kun gzhi gang rung las ma 'das pa'i phyir chos can sems kyi cha yin la/ phyi ma 'di yul med gzung 'dzin las 'das pa'i shes pa rang ngo shes pa'i rig cha go ma 'gag pa zhig yin pas na chos nyid rig pa'o// yang na snga ma de lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa yin la/ phyi ma 'di rang byung gi rig pa'o// yang na snga ma de gnas cha rang sar ma grol ba zhig yin la/ phyi ma 'di gnas cha rang sar grol ba zhig go /yang na snga ma de rmongs cha ma sangs ba zhig yin la/ phyi ma 'di mkhyen cha ma 'gag pa zhig go /go bde bar byas na/ snga ma de la gnas 'gyu ngo shes pa'i gsal cha yod kyang rang ngo shes pa'i rig cha med la/ phyi ma 'di gnas 'gyu ngo shes pa tsam du ma zad rang ngo rang shes kyi rig cha dwangs sing nge ba zhig lags so// de dag la rdzogs chen snying thig gong 'og gi man ngag rnams las ni/ sems dang rig pa/ kun gzhi dang chos sku/ rnam shes dang ye shes sogs shan 'byed bzhi dang*/ bcu gsum dang*/ bcu drug tu'ang gsungs so// de ltar gshis skye med la brtan pa thob par byas nas/

de nas gdangs 'gag med la rtsal sbyong tshul la gnyis las/ rtsal rnam rtog lhan skyes la nyams rtsal sbyong tshul ni gong du bshad zin pas slar bskyar ma dgos la/ gdangs snang ba lhan skyes la nyams rtsal sbyong tshul yang 'og tu ro gcig gcig gi skabs su 'byung bas 'dir de tsam mo// de nas rang gi sems nyid kyi rang bzhin ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje lhag par skye ste/ sha wa ris/ rtogs pa'i rang spyod rtsis med ngang de nas// rmongs pa'i 'gro ba nyam thag mngon gyur tshe// mi bzod snying rje'i shugs kyis 'chi ma 'khrugs// bdag gzhan ldog nas phan pa nyid la spyod// ces gsungs pa ltar 'byung*/ de'i tshe lus ngag yid gsum sems can thams cad kyi ched du lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par sad pa'i bskyed rim la sogs thabs kyi bya bas dus 'da' yang*/ lhag mthong bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab la goms pa'i tshul des bden par zhen pa yongs su sbyangs pa'i dbang gis/ dper na sngags kyis zin pa'i dug la longs spyod pas nyon mongs shing sdug bsngal bar mi 'gyur ba lta bu ste/ do ha las/ yul rnams brten kyang yul gyi mi gos te// ut+pal 'dab ma chu yis mi gos shing*// gang la rtsa ba rnal 'byor skyabs 'gro dang*// dug gi sngags can dug gis ga la tshugs// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// tshul 'di lta bu'i nyams len la dgongs nas bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis lam gang shar la spang blang med pa zhes gsungs par mdzad do// gsum pa spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la/ dus gsum gyi sgo nas dpyad pa dang*/ dngos po dngos med kyi sgo nas dpyad pa dang*/ gcig tha dad kyi sgo nas dpyad pa ste gsum las/ dang po dus gsum gyi sgo nas dpyad pa'i tshul ni/ de yang mnyam par 'jog pa'i rang tshugs ma shor ba'i ngang nas rtsal gyi shes rab phra mo des/ rang gi sems 'di 'das pa'i shes pa zhig gam/

ma 'ongs pa'i shes pa zhig gam/ da lta ba'i shes pa zhig gam/ de'ang dus gsum car ram gang rung gis bsdus pa ci yin zhes bab kyis bltas na/ shes pa gcig la dus gsum char gyis bsdus par ni bzhag tu med la/ de las dus gsum gang rung gis bsdus pa'o snyam na/ 'das pa'i sems ni 'gags shing zhig pas da lta ngos 'dzin du med/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems ni ma skyes shing ma 'byung bas da lta ngos 'dzin du med/ de'i shul na da lta ba las med/ de yang ngo bo dang dbyibs kha dog sogs 'di zhes ngos 'dzin du ci yang med la/ des na yul can sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral zhing*/ de bzhin byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtags kyang ma dmigs pas sems nyid spros bral zung 'jug lhan skyes kyi tshul la nges pa rnyed/ de bzhin du brtags pas yul gzugs sogs chos thams cad kyi gnas tshul yang de dang 'dra bar chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba zhig tu rtogs pa ste/ bden gnyis las/ kun rdzob 'di ltar snang ba 'di// rig pas brtags na 'ga' mi rnyed// ma rnyed pa nyid don dam yin// ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// des na chos thams cad snang tsam ma gtogs snang dus nyid nas snang ba snang ba'i go sa na bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa la rang gi blos yod par btags pa tsam du zad pas/ chos thams cad gdod nas skye ba dang 'gag pa dang gnas pa ci yang grub pa mi 'dug go snyam du rig pa ni/ sa ra has/ dngos po skye ba mkha' ltar rab zhi nas// dngos po rnam spangs phyis nas ci zhig skye// gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring bla ma mgon pos bstan pas rtogs// zhes gsungs pa ltar du dpyad pa'o// gnyis pa dngos po dngos med kyi sgo nas dpyad pa'i tshul ni/ de'ang mnyam par 'jog pa'i rang tshugs ma shor ba'i ngang nas rtsal gyi shes rab phra mo des/ rang gi sems 'di yod pa dngos por grub bam/

med pa dngos med du grub ces bab kyis blta/ dngos por grub bo snyam na/ gzung ba yul dang 'dzin pa yul can gang du grub ces blta/ bzung bar grub po snyam na/ 'o na dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis su grub dgos pas/ zlum po grub bzhi zla gam ngos mnyam mi mnyam mtho dman sogs dbyibs ci lta bu zhig tu grub/ de bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga sogs kha dog ci lta bu zhig tu grub blta/ 'dzin par grub po snyam na/ de'ang gzung ba la bltos nas bzhag pa yin pas/ gzung ba yul ma grub bas 'dzin pa'ang der snang ba nyid du zad la/ yang dngos po med pa zhig go snyam na/ 'o na sna tshogs su snang ba 'di gang gis byas zhes brtags pas dngos med nam mkha' dang gtan med mo sham gyi bu lta bur yang ma song bas/ de ltar brtags pa'i tshe ngo bor grub pa zhig yod na dngos por bzhag tu rung ste/ rig rtsal shes rab kyis brtags pa'i ngo na ci yang ma dmigs pas yod pa dngos po'i chos su bzhag tu ma rnyed/ so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul du gyur pas med pa dngos med kyi phyogs su'ang ma song zhing*/ des na sems dngos po dang dngos po med pa gnyis ka dang bral bas na rtag pa dang chad pa'i lam du ma lhung zhing dbus tsam du'ang mi gnas pas na dbu ma'i lam zhes bya ste/ mdo las/ bden dang rdzun pa 'di yang mtha' yin la// yod dang med pa 'di yang mtha' yin te// de phyir mtha' ni gnyis ka rnam spangs nas// mkhas pas dbus la yang ni gnas mi byed// ces so// de'ang klog pa thos bsam pa'i lugs ltar rtags kyi rjes su 'gro ba dang ldog pas gtan la phab pa'i don spyi blo yul du shar ba lta bu ma yin par/ 'dir bla ma'i man ngag gis ngo rang thog tu sprad pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag pas sems nyid spros bral gyi rang mtshan mngon sum du mthong ba'i tshul/ dper na lag pa'i mthil du gnas pa'i gter mthong ba lta bu'o// de la zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma chen po'i don mngon sum du mthong ba zhes bya ste/

de ni do ha mdzod las/ bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa// lag pa'i mthil du gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra// zhes gsungs pa de grub pa yin no// gsum pa gcig tha dad kyi sgo nas dpyad pa'i tshul ni/ de yang gong bzhin mnyam par 'jog pa'i rang tshugs ma shor ba'i ngang nas rtsal gyi shes rab phra mo des/ rang gi sems 'di gcig pu zhig gam yang na du ma zhig gcig pu yin snyam na/ sems zhes bya ba 'di dge ba'i rtog pa dad pa nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems sogs dang*/ mi dge ba'i rtog pa chags sdang rmongs gsum sogs sna tshogs su snang ba la btags pa nyid de/ gcig tu ji ltar bzhag du ma zhig go snyam na/ de thams cad kyang rang gi ngo bo stong nyid spros bral du mnyam par ji ltar 'gyur zhes bab kyis bltas pas/ gcig tha dad dang bcas pa dang*/ mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i dpyad stong las kyang 'das pa'i tha mal gyi shes pa sgrib bral rjen par mthong bas/ de la phyag rgya chen po spros bral rab tu mi gnas pa'i don mthong ba zhes bya'o// de ltar yang phyag rgya chen po rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ 'di ni phyag rgya chen po ste// 'di ni dri mas ma gos pa// 'di la dgag dang sgrub pa med// lam dang gnyen pos rnyed pa min// zhes so// de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa de'i mnyam bzhag tu so so rang rig pa'i ye shes 'ba' zhig las gzhan ci yang mi snang bas na snang ba med pa zhes bya la/ rjes thob tu lam 'dis chos thams cad la bden par zhen pa dag pa'i phyir rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur snang ba zhes bya ba yin no// de ni sa ra has/ mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// de ring mgon po nga ltar 'khrul pa chad// da ni su la'ang dri bar mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i thog tu son pa'o// de skabs 'khrul pa gang shar gyi thog tu de nyid gzhi med rtsa bral du shes pa la 'khrul thog tu grol ba'i gdengs rnyed pa zhes bya/

gzhi med rtsa bral du shes pa de las phyi chad 'khrul pa'i chos gtan nas mi rnyed pa la grol thog tu 'khrul pa'i mtshang rig pa zhes bya/ de nas ci zhig na/ 'khrul pa dang grol ba'am 'khor ba mya 'das zhes gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bar la de yang rig thog tu zhig pa na 'khrul grol gyi bar lag 'gyel ba zhes bya ste/ de dus spros bral gyi rang ngo 'phrod pa yin no// de lta bu'i spros bral gyi skabs su dngos por 'dzin pa'i spros pa dang bral ba'i cha nas ro gcig dang khyad med kyang*/ chos can sna tshogs pa'i rtsal du mar ma shar ba'i cha nas ro gcig las dman pa yin tshul sogs nyams myong gi spu ris 'byed thabs mang yang gzhan las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len la/ chos thams cad snang sems dbyer med du ro mnyam pa ro gcig gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ chos thams cad gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi skur gtan la phab nas sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa ste gnyis las/ dang po la'ang gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dpes snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa/ chu dang khyag rom gyi dpes snang stong zung 'jug du ngo sprod pa/ chu dang rlabs kyi dpes chos thams cad ro mnyam du gtan la dbab pa ste gsum las/ dang po gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dpes snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ gong smos spros bral gyi gnad la rdo rus thug par byas pa'i nyams myong de ro gcig gi rtogs par na spar ba'i ched du/ thog mar snang ba thams cad sems nyid kyi rang gdangs tsam du gtan la 'bebs pa ste/ de la snang ba dang snang yul tha dad du phye ba dang mi phye ba'i man ngag gi bka' srol gnyis su snang ba las/ 'dir rang lugs kyi gong ma rnams kyi phye bar snang ba la rtsal sbyong mdzad par bzhed pas/ de'i tshul yang*/ dper na gnyid kyi dus su rang nyid mal nas ma g.yos bzhin du rmi snang la sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal skye 'gro pho mo sogs ji ltar snang yang*/

gnyid las sad ma thag nyams phab nas dpyad na/ de thams cad rmi lam gyi sems las logs su med pa shes pa ltar/ da lta nyin mo'i dus kyi tshogs drug gi snang ba sna tshogs su 'char ba 'di thams cad kyang*/ gti mug gi gnyid log pa las byung ba'i rmi lam gyi snang ba yin zhing*/ de rnams kyang snang du nyid nas da ltar gyi sems las gzhan du bden grub rdul tsam yang med de/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gling gis/ gzhi rtsa bral ba'i sems nyid la// mdang rmi lam nyams su myong ba de// snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa'i// slob dpon gcig lags te go lags sam// zhes gsungs/ de yang snang ba gang snang gi yul thog de gar 'dzin med du glod nas rtsal sbyong gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa nyid kyis/ ci zhig na/ yul drug gi snang ba phyir ma chad cing yul can gyi sems nang du ma chad par snang sems dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par 'gyur ro// de yang 'dres pa zer ba chu dang 'o ma gnyis gcig tu bsres pa lta bu la go bar mi bya ste/ grub thob o rgyan pas/ sems dang snang ba gnyis po me dang tsha ba bzhin du gnas pa yin mod/ ces gsungs pa ltar ye nas snang sems dbyer med yin pa la yin par rtogs pa'i tha tshig go /'di slob pa'i zung 'jug yin pas/ do ha las/ khams gsum ma lus 'di dag thams cad ni// 'dod chags chen po gcig tu kha dog sgyur cig dang*// zhes gsungs/ de'i don yang*/ khams gsum gyi sgras lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ 'dod chags chen po'i sgras zung 'jug lhan skyes/ kha dog sgyur cig dang zhes pas de'i rang bzhin du gyis shig par gdams pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa chu dang khyag rom gyi dpes snang stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprod pa ni/ de yang sngar spros bral gyi dus nas snang stong tha mi dad par shes su zin mod/ de lta na'ang yul snang sgom du ma shar la/ 'dir ro gcig gi skabs su snang ba'i chos thams cad sems nyid gcig pu'i rgya las mi 'da' bar shes nas yul snang sgom du shar bas/

ji ltar dag ma dag sna tshogs su snang ba'i chos thams cad snang ba'i dus de nyid nas snang ba snang ba'i go sa na ngo bo cir yang ma grub par nyams su myong ba ni snang ba'i ngo bo stong pa zhes bya la/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub cing zhen 'dzin med bzhin du snang tshul ma 'gag par cir yang snang gi 'dug pa ni stong pa'i rang gdangs snang ba zhes bya'o// de ltar ye nas snang ba stong pa dang 'bral ma myong zhing*/ stong pa snang ba dang 'bral ma myong bas/ snang stong ngo bo nyid kyis 'du 'bral med pa'i gnas lugs kyi rang mtshan nyams 'og tu chud pa ni snang stong lhan skyes kyi rang ngo mthong ba dang*/ snang stong zung 'jug mngon du gyur pa zhes bya/ de dus chos can rnam pa thams cad par snang ba de thams cad chos nyid stong pa nyid gcig pu'i rgya las mi 'da' bar mthong ba la snang stong ro gcig tu rtogs pa zhes bya ste/ dper na rnam pa khyag pa sna tshogs su snang yang snang dus nyid nas ngo bo chu las mi 'da' bar shes pa bzhin no// tshul des bde stong zung 'jug dang*/ gsal stong zung 'jug dang*/ rig stong zung 'jug rnams kyang rigs 'gre nas shes par bya zhing*/ de dag la du ma ro gcig tu rtogs pa zhes bya'o// de yang ri khrod zhabs kyis/ gaṅgā la sogs chu klung sna tshogs pa// ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar// brtag pa'i sems dang sems byung sna tshogs kun// chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig shes par gyis// zhes dang*/ bram ze chen pos/ rtog par gyur na thams cad de yin te// de las gzhan zhig sus kyang rnyed mi 'gyur// klog pa de yin 'dzin dang sgom pa'ang de// bstan bcos snying la 'chang ba'ang de yin no// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// gsum pa chu dang rlabs kyi dpes chos thams cad ro mnyam du gtan la dbab pa ni/ de yang dper na/ chu rlabs thams cad chu nyid las shar ba bzhin du/ gzugs sgra la sogs sna tshogs su snang ba'i chos thams cad kyang rang gi sems nyid stong pa'i rtsal gdangs 'gag med rnam pa thams cad par shar ba'i tshul gyis byas pa lta bur rtogs pa ste/

sa ra has/ ji srid sems las rnams 'phros pa// de srid mgon po'i rang bzhin te// chu dang rlabs dag gzhan yin nam// zhes dang*/ rba rlabs ji ltar che yang rgya mtsho'i ngang*// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// 'di la sems kyi chos nyid gcig rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba ro gcig du mar shar ba zhes bya ste/ de yang kun spyod las/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid// gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad do// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gcig shes kun grol zhes pa'ang 'di lta bu la zer ba yin no// 'di rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa la rjes shes stong pa nyid kun tu 'gro bar 'char bar 'gyur ro// de skabs snang ba thams cad snang tsam gyi dus nyid du sems nyid du rtogs pa ni snang thog tu sems kyi 'dug tshul rig pa zhes bya la/ sems nyid kyi gdangs rnam pa thams cad par shar ba ni sems thog tu snang ba'i 'char tshul rtogs pa zhes bya'o// de nas ci zhig na/ snang ba dang sems gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bar la de yang rig thog tu zhig pa na snang sems bar lag 'gyel ba zhes bya ste/ de dus ro gcig gi rang ngo 'phrod pa yin no// de lta bu'i ro gcig gi skabs su chos thams cad ro mnyam du shar ba'i cha nas sgom med dang khyad med kyang*/ nyams len gyi rtsol ba dbyings su ma zad pa'i cha nas sgom med las dman pa yin tshul sogs nyams myong gi spu ris 'byed thabs mang yang gzhan las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa chos thams cad gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi skur gtan la phab nas sgom med kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul ni/ khrid gzhung du'ang sa bcad tsam las ma gsungs pa 'brel med smra ba'i sgo yang bsdam pa las 'os med do// 'bru don tsam ni/ dper na/ bud shing zad pa na me yang zad pa bzhin du/ spang bya nyon mongs pa mtha' dag zad pa na spong byed kyi gnyen po yang zad nas/

phar phyin theg par lam chad de de las gzhan du phyin sa med cing*/ 'jug pa chad de de las gong du 'phul sa med pas/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das thob par bshad pa ltar/ 'dir yang sgom med kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa na mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gam phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ de ni bsre skor gyi gzhung las/ kye ho/ 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min// til+li ngas ni ci yang bstan du med// rang gis rang nyid 'tshol te shes par byos// zhes gnyug ma chig chod du gdams par mdzad pa dang*/ mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing*// mi bsgom mi sems rang babs bzhag /ces til+li pa'i chos drug tu gdams par mdzad pa ltar ste de'i don yang yi ge mang gis dogs nas spro bar ma byas so// de dag gi gnas skabs thams cad du chos nyid nyag gcig pa'i snang ba las mi g.yo ba ni rjes thob tu chos nyid kyi ngang las mi g.yo ba zhes bya la/ chos nyid de ka thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pas 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du sems can la phan bde sgrub par mdzad pa ni mnyam bzhag tu thugs rje'i klong brdol ba zhes bya'o// thugs rje chen pos gzhan don mdzad pa la rjes thob kyi ming btags pa tsam yin gyi/ don la ni mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig yin no// de la mnyam rjes bar lag 'gyel ba zhes dang*/ sgom med rang ngo 'phrod pa zhes dang*/ sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa zhes dang*/ snang srid sku gsum du 'char ba zhes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa zhes dang*/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhes bya'o// zhes so/// / gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ phyag rgya chen po ngos bzung zhing rang ngo sprod pa dang*/ gegs dang gol shor gcod pa dang*/ nyams rtogs go ba gsum gyi shan 'byed pa dang gsum las/ dang po phyag rgya chen po ngos bzung zhing rang ngo sprad pa ni/

bshad ma thag pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi po re re bzhin/ gzhi gtan la phab pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ lam nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ nyams myong gi spu ris 'byed pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi// sa lam gyi drod rtags 'byed pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi ste bzhi tshan lnga po rnams so// de dag ni kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos/ phyag rgya chen po'i bshad pa thams cad kyi bla ma zhes bya ba'i rtsa tshig tu/ gzhi dang nyams len nyams myong dang*// drod rtags 'byed dang 'bras bu ni// mngon gyur rnal 'byor bzhi po 'dir// lam ni nges pa'i mdor bsdus so// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/ rang 'grel nges don lta ba'i mig ces bya bas rgyas par bkral ba sogs las shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir bsdu na/ yang dgon pas/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i bzhed kyis/ rkyen gsum dang bral ba/ dga' ba bzhi las 'das pa/ 'od gsal las khyad par du gyur pa zhig bzhed pas/ phyag rgya chen po bde ba'i rkyen la mi ltos/ gsal ba'i rkyen la mi ltos/ mi rtog pa'i rkyen la mi ltos pas rkyen gsum la mi ltos pa'o// dga' ba bzhi las lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ni/ bla mas bstan du yod la slob mas go ru yod pas/ mtshon bya mtshon byed dang bcas pa'i dpe'i ye shes yin/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ bla mas bstan du med la slob mas go ru med/ nyams dang myong bas ma sbags/ rtogs pa dang nges shes kyis ma bslad/ lta sgom spyod pas ma phye/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ris su ma bcad pa/ 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos 'di dag thams cad la/ bsal bzhag gam/ bcing grol lam/ gnyen pos bzo gcig kyang ma byas pa/ rang sar rang ngo shes shing rang grol ba la phyag rgya chen po zer ba yin no// 'od gsal ni snang med spros bral yin la/ phyag rgya chen po ni snang rig so ma spros pa rang grol yin pas/

'od gsal las khyad par du gyur pa yin no// zhes dang*/ mdor na tha mal gyi shes pa sus kyang bzo ma byas pa'i ang so re ba 'di/ kho rang gi kho rang ngo shes pa de la phyag rgya chen po'i dge sbyor skyes pa zer ba yin no zhes gsungs/ de ni sha wa ris/ tha mal shes pa rang lugs gnyug ma la// bcos ma'i dmigs pa dag gis mi slad de// zhes dang*/ ma bzung ma btang rang ga nyid du zhog /ces dang*/ rje mi las/ tha mal shes pa skyong skyong nas// ma rig 'khrul pa brjed de thal// zhes dang*/ rje dwags pos/ tha mal shes pas chog pa'i nyams len 'di// sangs rgyas mi gzugs can gyi drin las rnyed// ces so// de 'dra'i zab gnad zin par dka' tshul/ rje yang dgon pas/ nyams dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag phyed cing sgom du ngo sprod pa'i bla ma ni mang la/ tha mal gyi shes pa sgom du ngo sprod pa'i bla ma ni nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang dkon pa yin no// zhes gsungs/ ngo sprad bya tha mal gyi shes pa'am rang bzhin gyi shes pa 'di ni/ spyi skad la/ 'khrul rtog tha mal gyi shes pa dang*/ nyams zhen tha mal gyi shes pa dang*/ gnas lugs tha mal gyi shes pa zhes gsum du phye ba'i phyi ma dang don gcig ste/ de yang rang thog tu ngo sprod pa'i dbang du byed na/ rang gi sems nyid ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzo med rang lugs su lhod de bzhag pas/ 'das pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'gag ma 'ongs pa'i rnam par rtog pa ma skye ba'i bar de na/ tha mal gyi shes pa gshis cir yang ma grub cing*/ gdangs gar yang ma 'gag pa/ ngo bo cir yang mi rtog pa/ yul med kyi shes pa gsal stong blo las 'das pa/ dper na nam mkha' dwangs ma'i dkyil lta bu zhig rang sar rang ngo shes pa'i rgyun yengs med 'dzin med du bskyangs pa la lam rang byung snying po'i rang 'gros zhes bya ste/ de lta'i rang mtshan ji bzhin rtogs goms mthar 'don byed na/ tshe lus 'di gar re dogs kyi thag pa chad/

the tshom gyi sgrog las grol/ gnyis 'dzin gyi mdud pa zhig sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma dgas lam gyi 'jug pa chad de/ snang srid sku gsum gyi rol par 'char nas don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par nges so// zhes bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas thos so/// / gnyis pa gegs dang gol shor gcod pa la/ snang ba dgrar langs kyi gegs dang*// rnam rtog dgrar langs kyi gegs dang*/ stong pa dgrar langs kyi gegs te gsum las/ dang po snang ba dgrar langs kyi gegs ni/ phyi'i tshogs drug gi yul snang mthong thos myong ba'i skabs su de dag gi sgom la gnod pa 'dra zhig 'byung na snang ba dgra langs kyi gegs te/ pha dam pas/ snang ba dgrar langs khang stong rkun ma 'dra// don la thob shor med do ding ri ba// zhes gsungs/ de sel thabs ni/ sngar snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa'i gnad 'dir yang dran par byas nas snang ba thams cad sems su shes pas sel bar 'gyur te/ sha wa ris/ rang gi sems nyid rtogs na phyag rgya chen po ste// ji ltar snang ba 'di yang rang gi sems las logs na med// ces dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa rnam rtog dgrar langs kyi gegs ni/ nang rnam rtog dang nyon mongs pa'i 'gyu ba hrag pa shar drags pa'i skabs su de dag gis sgom la gnod pa 'dra zhig byung na rnam rtog dgrar langs kyi gegs te/ pha dam pas/ rnam rtog ngan pa spang la chu rdol 'dra// bkag bas khegs pa med do ding ri ba// zhes gsungs/ de sel thabs ni/ sngar rnam rtog lhan skyes su ngo sprod pa'i gnad 'dir yang dran pa byas nas rnam rtog chos skur ngo shes pas sel bar 'gyur te/ sa ra has/ rnam rtog ye shes chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem byed yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// gsum pa stong pa dgrar langs kyi gegs ni/

res 'ga' lus sems snod bcud gang la'ang gtad so med par stong nyid du 'byams klas drag pa'i skabs su des las 'bras la gnod pa 'dra zhig byung na stong pa dgrar langs kyi gegs te/ sa ra has/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*// des ni lam mchog rnyed par mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs/ de sel thabs ni/ sngar snang stong lhan skyes su ngo sprod pa'i gnad 'dir yang dran par byas nas snang stong zung 'jug tu shes pas sel bar 'gyur te/ nā ro pas/ snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang*// de phyir snang stong dbyer med do// zhes dang*/ 'ba' ra bas/ snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di// me long nang gi byad dang 'dra// zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// gol sa gsum ni/ zhi gnas kyi bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams la zhen pa ste/ de yang bde nyams 'dod chags dang mthun/ de lta bu'i bde nyams gang zhig zhen pa dang bcas pas bskyangs na des 'dod khams su gol nas 'gro/ gsal nyams zhe sdang dang mthun/ de lta bu'i gsal nyams gang zhig 'dzin pa dang bcas pas bskyangs na de gzugs khams su gol nas 'gro/ mi rtog pa'i nyams gti mug dang mthun/ de lta bu'i mi rtog par nyams gang zhig blos byas kyis bskyangs na des gzugs med khams su gol nas 'gro la/ zhen 'dzin blos byas kyis ma bslad kyang*/ gnas lugs kyi rang zhal gsal rgyas rdzogs par ma mthong na nyan rang gi 'bras bur gol bar gsungs so// de 'dra'i gol sa gsum po gcod pa'i thabs ni/ zhi gnas kyi nyams de rnams gzhi rtsa bral ba'i stong nyid kyi don la nges pa rnyed pa'i lhag mthong bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab tu na spar bas sel bar 'gyur ro// zhes so// shor sa bzhi ni/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la shor ba dang*/ stong nyid lam du shor ba dang*/ stong nyid gnyen por shor ba dang*/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba ste bzhi/ de la ye shor dang 'phral shor bzhi tshan gnyis su dbye ru yod kyang*/

'dir ma phye ba'i dbang du byas pa las/ dang po stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la shor ba ni/ gong gi stong pa dgrar langs dang phyogs 'dra bar stong rkyang la zhen nas las 'bras khyad du bsad pa zhig ste/ 'on kyang gong gi stong pa dgrar langs te sgom pa'i skyon gtso bo dang*/ 'di ni lta ba'i skyon gtso bo yin pas zlos skyon du mi 'gyur la/ sel thabs ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can dang snying rje stong nyid kyi rang bzhin can te zung 'jug tu langs pas gcod par 'gyur te/ rtsa shes las/ gang zhig rten 'byung ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// de phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ byang chub sems 'grel du/ kun rdzob stong pa nyid du bshad// stong nyid kho na kun rdzob yin// zhes pa ltar ro// stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni/ dge chos thams cad ye nas thabs shes zung 'jug tu gnas pa de ma shes par/ dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa sogs thabs kyi cha gang yang rung ba dngos mtshan can du bsgoms nas slar mi rtog blos byas kyis bslad pa'i shes rab stong pa nyid kyis rgyas btab pa zhig ste/ sel thabs ni/ ye nas thabs shes dbyer med dam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin lugs yin bzhin par rdzogs pas gcod par byed do// stong nyid gnyen por shor ba ni/ spang gnyen ye nas dbyer med pa de ma go bar/ spang bya'i nyon mongs dang gnyen po ye shes tha dad du bzung nas dgag sgrub tu rtog pa zhig ste/ sel thabs ni/ sngar smos pa ltar spang gnyen dbyer med rang shar rang grol du skyong bas khegs par 'gyur ro// stong nyid lam du shor ba ni// gzhi lam 'bras bu dbyer med kyi don ma go bar/ lam stong pa nyid ces gzhan zhig bsgoms pa las/ 'bras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan gyis sangs rgyas zhes bya ba gzhan zhig thob tu re nas stong nyid bsgoms pa zhig ste/

sel thabs ni/ shar grol snga phyi med par dus mnyam dang sku gsum rang chas su gnas par rtogs pas khegs par 'gyur ro// gsum pa nyams rtogs go ba gsum gyi shan 'byed ni/ sems kyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis rtogs pa go ba/ don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa rtse gcig ste nyams/ mngon sum du rtogs pa spros bral man chad la rtogs pa zhes bya la/ sgra 'jug pa gcig pa'i dbang gis thams cad la rtogs pa zhes sbyar yang 'gal ba med do// zhes kun mkhyen pad dkar rang gis bzhed la/ rje yang dgon pas ni/ don spyi ma nor ba blo yul du shar ba go ba/ rang mtshan gyi rnam pa phyogs gcig nyams 'og tu tshud pa nyams myong*/ rang mtshan ma 'khrul bar mngon du gyur pa la rtogs pa zhes dang*/ yang na/ blo yul du shar nas yid ches pa go ba/ de sems kyi myong ba nyams/ sems rang de'i ngo bor shar ba la rtogs pa zhes kyang gsungs so// da ni zhar la rnal 'byor bzhi po de dag so so'i khyad par ci rigs su snang ba las/ thog mar dran pa'i dbye ba bzhi ni/ gong ma phal che bas/ rtse gcig rnam rtog bzung dran/ spros bral stong nyid dran pa/ ro gcig skye med dran pa/ sgom med blo 'das dran pa/ zhes dang*/ yang 'ga' zhig gis/ rtse gcig gong dang 'dra ba la/ spros bral skye med dran pa/ ro gcig blo 'das dran pa/ sgom med dbyings su thim pa/ zhes kyang gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngos 'dzin bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis/ ngang la gnas pa rtse gcig yin// sgro 'dogs chod pa spros bral yin// spang blang med na ro gcig yin// myong ba dag na sgom med yin// zhes dang*/ mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis// rtse gcig dus su ngo bo rtogs// spros bral dus su rang bzhin rtogs// ro gcig snang ba'i mtshan nyid rtogs// sgom med rtogs pa khor yug ma// zhes dang*/ rtogs pa'i 'khor sa bzhi ni/ rje des/

rtse gcig mun pa'i dkyil na 'byams// spros bral med pa'i stong rtsis khyer// ro gcig 'dres pa'i rba la g.yengs// sgom med nyi ma sprin gyis sgrib// ces dang*/ rjes shes kyi skye tshul bzhi ni/ rje des/ rtse gcig gi rjes shes a 'thas su skye// spros bral gyi rjes shes sgyu mar skye// ro gcig gi rjes shes stong par skye// sgom med kyi rjes shes snying rjer skye// zhes dang*/ rjes shes kyi dri ma bzhi ni/ rje des/ rtse gcig la dngos 'dzin gyi dri ma yod// spros bral la ngo ma shes kyi dri ma yod// ro gcig la nyams kyi dri ma yod// sgom med la shes bya'i dri ma yod// ces dang*/ rjes thob 'dag tshul bzhi ni/ rje des/ rtse gcig bral yod thob pa med// spros bral bral thob gnyis ka yod// ro gcig bral med thob pa yod// sgom med bral thob gnyis ka med// ces dang*/ mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams bzhi ni/ rje des/ rtse gcig rang sa'i mnyam rjes yod// spros bral mnyam rjes so sor 'byed// ro gcig dus su mnyam rjes 'dres// sgom med mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig go /zhes dang*/ sgom dus bzhi ni/ rje des/ rtse gcig a 'thas sgom pa'i dus// spros bral stong par sgom pa'i dus// ro gcig zung 'jug sgom pa'i dus// sgom med mngon du gyur ba'i dus// zhes gsungs/ mnyam bzhag phung po lnga bral gyi rtogs pas rjes shes tshogs brgyad kyi dag lugs bzhi ni/ rje yang dgon pas/ rtse gcig dus su gzugs kyi phung po dang bral/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes dag spros bral gyi dus su tshor ba dang 'du shes kyi phung po dang bral/ yid kyi rnam shes dag ro gcig gi dus su 'du byed kyi phung po dang bral/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dag sgom med kyi dus su rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang bral/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dag go /zhes gsungs/ nyams rtogs kyi sa mtshams bzhi ni/

rje sgom chung gis/ rtse gcig nyams rtogs dri ma can// spros bral nyams rtogs ru shan 'byed// ro gcig nyams rtogs zung du 'jug sgom med rtogs pa khor yug ma// zhes dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi mkhyen tshul bzhi ni/ rje des/ rtse gcig gi dus su rgyu 'bras a 'thas/ spros bral gyi dus su rgyu 'bras sgyu ma lta bu/ ro gcig gi dus su rgyu 'bras nam mkha' lta bu/ sgom med kyi dus su gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung mkhyen pa'o// zhes so// bogs 'don bzhi ni/ rtse gcig gi bogs brtson 'grus kyis 'don/ spros bral gi bogs mos gus kyis 'don/ ro gcig gi bogs snying rjes 'don/ sgom med ni bogs 'don dang bral ba'o// gegs sel bzhi ni// rtse gcig gi gegs bzhag thabs kyis sel/ spros bral gyi gegs sgom pa nyid kyis sel/ ro gcig dang sgom med ni gegs sel las 'das pa'o// zhes so// gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad par bzhi ni/ rje zla 'od gzhon nus/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ni/ gsal la ma 'gag pa skad cig ma'i shes pa de yin/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor ni/ rig pa'i ngo bo skye med du mthong bas/ yar sangs rgyas la mi re/ mar 'khor ba la mi dogs/ bar du snang ba la mi 'dzin/ gzhan gyis bsgyur du mi btub pa'o// ro gcig gi rnal 'byor ni/ snang stong dbyer med du rtogs pa'o// sgom med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ cir snang cir skyes ngo bo gcig tu shar nas dran rtog thams cad sgom du song ba yin/ zhes dang*/ rnam rtog la gnyen pos 'jun dgos na rtse gcig dran tsam la ngo bo rnyed na spros bral/ snang thog tu grol ba thob na ro gcig bsgom bya sgom byed zad pa sgom med do// ces dang*/ dran pa rnam rtog tu langs pa rtse gcig rnam rtog dran par song ba spros bral/ rnam rtog chos skur 'char ba ro gcig rnam rtog dbyings su dag pa sgom med// ces gsungs so// yang rtse gcig nal gyi bu dang 'dra// skye ba mang ste khas len nyung*// spros bral spyi rta sgal can 'dra// kha 'dzin mang ste ched gnyer nyung*// ro gcig gter gyi kha byang 'dra// gleng ba mang ste thon pa nyung*// sgom med rgyal po'i gdan sa 'dra// smon pa mang ste thob pa nyung*// zhes so// chos rje rgya ras kyis/

rtse gcig nyams kyi mtho dman yin// 'jig rten lam ste las rnams gsog /spros bral pha yul mthong ba yin// phal cher bsgom la res 'jog byed// ro gcig snang ba sgom du shar// khor yug ma ru song ba yin// sgom med chos sku'i gdan sa yin// bya rtsol thams cad dbyings su thim// zhes dang*/ rtse gcig bskyangs yun ring lags na/ 'dod yon zhen pa dbang med ldog mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa// drang srong yon tan cha shas tsam// spros bral rtogs pa bskyang ba na// rdzun snang nges med ltad mor che// sbyangs stobs dbang po rno rtul gyis// sems dpa'i yon tan cha shas 'byung*// zhen med snying rje 'char thang yin// ro gcig bskyangs yun ring lags na// sangs rgyas zhing khams ltad mor che// 'dre log spyi gtsug gar song yang*// rgyal po gdan las g.yo ba med// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel shar tshe la// nyi ma'i gung la za 'og bkram// sangs rgyas yon tan cha shas tsam// 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung*// sgom med rab tu song tsam na// mdzad pa mthar 'don yon tan 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin gtsang smyon gyis/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad thol skyes kyi rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du rdzogs shing tshang la/ de yang gzhi lam 'bras gsum mam rnal 'byor bzhi'i ngo bor gnas te/ tshogs drug gi snang ba zhig shar tsam na ngang las mi g.yo bas na rtse gcig rtse gcig gi dus na mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral bas na spros bral/ spros pa dang bral ba'i dus na 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du ro gcig pas na ro gcig ro gcig gi dus na blo las 'das pas na sgom med do// zhes dang*/ thol skyes kyi rnam rtog so ma las grwa chag zur nyams med pa rtse gcig rang ngo shes pa spros bral/ gsal stong zung 'jug tu myong ba ro gcig blo 'das chen por grol ba sgom med do// zhes dang*// so ma nyams pa rtse gcig

lhug pa spros bral/ rang dwangs ro gcig brjod bral sgom med do// zhes dang*/ skye med las mi 'da' ba rtse gcig 'gag med du 'char ba spros bral/ gnyis med du myong ba ro gcig myong dag tu 'gro ba sgom med do// zhes dang*/ rje pad+ma dkar pos/ mi rtog pa'i ngang du bzhag pa rtse gcig skye med kyi ngang du bzhag pa spros bral/ gnyis med kyi ngang du bzhag pa ro gcig gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag pa sgom med do// zhes dang*/ mdo khams pa thugs kyi rdo rjes/ mnyam bzhag la ji tsam 'dod par gnas thub pa rtse gcig tha mal gyi shes pa rang ngo shes shing gzhi rtsa med par rtogs pa spros bral/ 'khor 'das gnyis snang gi 'dzin pa rig thog tu grol ba ro gcig nges shes bag chags kyi dri ma thams cad dag pa sgom med/ ces dang*/ yang de nyid kyis/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku ni rgya mtsho dang 'dra ste kun gyi gzhi yin/ de'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la rtse gcig tu bzhag rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rtsal ni rgya mtsho'i rlabs dang 'dra ste chos sku'i rang rtsal yin/ de'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la spros bral du bzhag snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od ni rgya mtsho'i nang du gzugs brnyan sna tshogs shar ba dang 'dra ste/ bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin/ de'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la ro gcig tu bzhag rtogs pa de gsum mthar phyin nas 'bad rtsol gyi sgom du med pa ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ste sgom med du bzhag pa'o// zhes gsungs pa sogs mang ngo*// yang rje sgam po pa'i man ngag bzhin du phag grus rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis su dbye ba'i tshul las/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor gsum ni/ rje phag grus/ rtse gcig chung ngu sems bde gsal gyi ngo bo mthong ba dang*/ 'bring po ting nge 'dzin de la rang dbang thob pa dang*/ chen po de'i nyams khor yug tu song ba'o// zhes gsungs/

de'i don ni/ rnam rtog phal cher rang sar zhi nas sems bde gsal gyi ngo bo sa le sing nge rjen ne bar mthong zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin de thog mar skyong dka' ba tsam nas bzung ste nam sgom ring la 'char zhing*/ ma bsgom na 'khrul 'byams la 'chor ba'i bar la rtse gcig chung ngu zhes bzhed/ de nas res 'ga' ma bsgom pa'i skabs na'ang de nyid 'char zhing*/ bsgoms pa'i tshe gsal cha dang brtan cha che ru song nas/ ting nge 'dzin de la rang dbang thob pa la rtse gcig 'bring po zhes bzhed/ mthar mnyam rjes gang gi skabs su'ang ting nge 'dzin de rgyun chad med par shar zhing*/ mtshan mo'i gnyid kyang phal cher de'i ngang du 'byams pa ste nyin mtshan khor yug tu song ba la rtse gcig chen po zhes bzhed par mdzad do// spros bral gyi rnal 'byor gsum ni/ rje phag grus/ spros bral chung ngu rang sems skye med du rtogs pa dang*/ 'bring po rtsa ba bral bar rtogs pa dang*/ chen po phyi nang gi chos thams cad la sgro 'dogs chod pa'o// zhes gsungs/ de'i don ni/ rang sems kyi ngo bo dngos po'i chos su ma skye/ dngos med kyi chos su ma 'gag tha dad kyi chos su mi gnas par skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi spros pa dang bral bar rtogs kyang*/ stong 'dzin dang ma bral zhing 'khor 'das la re dogs yod pa la spros bral chung ngu zhes bzhed/ de nas stong 'dzin gyi nyams de dag cing*/ tha mal gyi shes pa yul med du lhang gis song ste/ snang 'dzin dang stong 'dzin gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs nas 'gyu thog tu sgro 'dogs chod kyang*/ snang thog tu sgro 'dogs ma chod pas a 'thas kyi re dogs dum re yod pa la spros bral 'bring po zhes bzhed/ de nas nyams kyi dag byed rtogs pas byas shing rtogs pa'i bogs nyams kyis dbyung nas bskyangs pas/ mthar 'khor 'das kyis bsdus shing shes bya la srid tshad kyi phyi nang gi chos thams cad la mtshan ma'i spros pa dang bral zhing 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa la spros bral chen po zhes bzhed do// ro gcig gi rnal 'byor gsum ni/

rje phag grus/ ro gcig chung ngu 'khor 'das gcig tu 'dres pa dang*/ 'bring po gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba chod pa dang*/ chen po chos thams cad mnyam nyid kyi ngang du zhi ba'o// zhes gsungs/ de'i don ni/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor rtogs nas du ma ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur kyang*/ de'i nyams myong dang nges shes kyi 'dzin 'khris yod pa la ro gcig chung ngu zhes bzhed/ de nas du ma ro gcig tu nyams su myong ba'i nges shes kyi 'dzin 'khris dag nas/ gzung ba yul dang 'dzin pa sems kyi rtsa ba chod pas yul snang bem po'i rnam par phyir ma chad/ yul can gyi shes pa gsal rig gi rnam par nang du ma chad par/ ye nas snang sems dbyer med yin lugs ji lta bu'i don mngon du gyur pa la ro gcig 'bring po zhes bzhed/ mthar du ma ro gcig tu rtogs shing*/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa de du mar shar te/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad mnyam nyid gnyug pa'i ngang du zhi nas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la rang dbang thob pa la ro gcig chen po zhes bzhed do// sgom med kyi rnal 'byor gsum ni/ rje phag grus/ sgom med chung ngu bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba dang*/ 'bring po lhun grub kyi rang sa zin pa dang*/ chen po 'od gsal gnyis med du 'dres pa'o// zhes gsungs/ de'i don ni/ gnyis snang phal cher dag nas ched du mnyam par bzhag nas bsgom ma dgos/ dran pas bzung ma dgos par snang ba thams cad sgom du shar nas bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bar gyur kyang*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams myong gi 'dzin pa cung zad tsam yod pa'i bar la sgom med chung ngu zhes bzhed/ de nas sgyu ma lta bu'i gnyis snang phra mo zhig yod la/ de rang gsal du 'char ba la sgom med 'bring po zhes bzhed/ mthar rnam shes kyi cha phra mo de yang dag nas lam 'od gsal dang 'bras bu'i 'od gsal gnyis dbyer med du 'dres te ye shes kyi klong 'byams 'ba' zhig tu gyur cing*/

rang don chos kyi skur byang chub nas gzhan don du gzugs sku snang ba gang 'dul du shar te/ 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du 'gro don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba la sgom med chen po zhes bzhed do// de dag ni sgom med dngos te/ rje rgya ras kyis/ sgom med chen po sangs rgyas sa// zhes dang*/ sgom med chos sku'i gdan sa yin// zhes gsungs/ de las gzhan du sgom nyams khor yug tu song ba'i sgom med 'dra ba ni rtse gcig gi dus nas 'byung ba dang*/ bsgom bya sgom byed dbyer med pa'i sgom med tsam ni spros bral gyi dus nas 'byung ba dang*/ cir snang thams cad sgom du shar nas mnyam rjes med pa'i sgom med zhig ni ro gcig gi dus nas 'byung ba ste/ de rnams la btags pa ba nyams kyi sgom med ces bya tshul/ rje des/ phal cher sgom med btags par song*// zhes so// chos rje 'brug pa'i gsung rgyun rnal 'byor bzhi'i phra zhib las/ rnal 'byor bzhi po re re la yang bzhi bzhir dbye bas bcu drug tu 'gyur ba'i tshul ni/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos/ ji skad bshad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi// yon tan nyid kyi rjes 'gro bas// rnam bzhi re re'i dbye ba yang*/ bzhi bzhi bcu drug dag tu gnas// zhes gsungs/ de'i don yang*/ gong du bshad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi dang yon tan cha 'dra ba'i sgo nas/ rnal 'byor bzhi tshan re re la yang nang gses su bzhi bzhir dbye bar mdzad pa ste/ de las rtse gcig gi rtse gcig ni/ rnam g.yeng gi rtog pa zhi ba'i ngang du rtse gcig tu gnas pa de la bzhed/ rtse gcig gi spros bral ni/ gnas pa de'i ngos nas mtshan ma'i spros pa mi dmigs pa de la bzhed/ rtse gcig gi ro gcig ni/ ngo bo mi rtog pa dang rnam pa bde ba dang gsal ba de la/ nyams kyi bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum ro gcig tu 'dres pa de la bzhed/ rtse gcig gi sgom med ni/

de la brtan pa thob nas nyin mtshan khor yug tu song ba de la bzhed do// spros bral gyi rtse gcig ni/ gang shar gyi ngo bo la yang dag gi dran pa ma yengs par rtse gcig tu lta ba de la bzhed/ spros bral gyi spros bral ni/ bltas pa'i tshe na spros pa'i mtha' gang du yang ma grub pa de la bzhed/ spros bral gyi ro gcig ni/ thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang du ro gcig pa de la bzhed/ spros bral gyi sgom med ni/ de la brtan pa thob nas nyin mtshan khor yug tu song ba de la bzhed do// ro gcig gi rtse gcig ni/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du sgro 'dogs chod pa de la bzhed/ ro gcig gi spros bral ni/ tha dad dam gnyis su 'dzin pa'i spros pa thams cad mnyam nyid de'i ngang du 'bral ba med pa de la bzhed/ ro gcig gi ro gcig ni/ mnyam pa nyid des chos thams cad la longs spyod pa'am/ 'jug pa'am/ thams cad la khyab par rol pa de la bzhed/ ro gcig gi sgom med ni/ de la brtan pa thob nas nyin mtshan khor yug tu song ba de la bzhed do// sgom med kyi rtse gcig ni/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i ngang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa de la bzhed/ sgom med kyi spros bral ni/ blo las 'das te blo'i spros pa thams cad las grol ba de la bzhed/ sgom med kyi ro gcig ni/ srid pa dang zhi ba thams cad sgom med de'i dbyings su ro gcig pa de las dbye rgyu rdul tsam yang med pa de la bzhed/ sgom med kyi sgom med ni/ de la brtan pa thob pa zhig ste/ ro gcig man chad kyi brtan pa thob pa ni gnas skabs kyi mnyam rjes 'dres pa dang*/ sgom med kyi brtan pa thob pa ni/ mthar thug gi mnyam rjes 'dres pa'o// dper na bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa dang rdzogs rim la brtan pa thob pa lta bu'o// zhes bzhed par mdzad do// yang rnal 'byor bzhi po re re la yang drug drug tu dbye bas nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'gyur tshul yang*/

kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos/ ngo mthong rnam rtog sgom du shar// rtsal rdzogs yon tan skyes pa dang*// kun rdzob byan tshud gzugs kyi sku'i// sa bon thebs dang ma thebs dbye// zhes gsungs/ de'i don yang rnal 'byor bzhi po la chung 'bring chen po'i dbye bas/ ngo bo mthong ma mthong*/ rnam rtog sgom du shar ma shar/ rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs/ yon tan rgyud la skyes ma skyes/ kun rdzob la rang byan tshud ma tshud/ gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs ma thebs kyi phra zhib 'byed par mdzad pa'o// de dag la brten nas dpal 'brug pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa rabs nas rabs su byon pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i gzhung dbye gsung 'gros zhal gdams kyi skor ji snyed cig bzhugs pa rnams las gsungs pa'i zab gnad kyang smos kyis mi lang ngo*// gzhan yang sa lam bgrod tshul ni/ chos dang gang zag gnyis ka phyag rgya chen por song ba lta thog nas sgom pa 'tshol ba'i lugs la/ sa lam spang rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad cig car du rdzogs pa yin te/ grub chen til+li pas dpal nā ro par gnyug ma chig chod du ngo sprod de bsgoms pas spang gnyen rang grol du dag nas sa lam chig rdzogs ye grol du song ba lta bu'o// des na rje zhang gis/ phyag rgya chen po chig chod la// rmongs pas sa lam brtsi ba 'khrul// zhes gsungs/ chos phyag rgya chen po yin yang gang zag de ltar ma song ba sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba'i lugs la/ sa lam spang rtogs kyi yon tan zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin rim gyis rdzogs dgos pa yin pas/ des na mtshan nyid theg pa'i rjod byed sa bcu lam lnga'i go don lhongs dgos pa byung*/ de ma lhongs na brjod bya'i don la rmongs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dir sa bcu lam lnga dang rnal 'byor bzhi po rim gyis lto sbyar tshul gsungs te/ rje zhang gis/ 'on kyang rmongs pa dga' ba'i phyir// mtshan nyid theg pa'i sa lam rnams/

'dir yang dod po brtsi bar bya// zhes sogs dang*/ chos rje 'brug pas/ sa sogs lam la dgos med kyang*// 'on kyang bstan na 'di ltar 'dod// maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba tshogs kyi lam// nyams myong skyes pa sbyor ba'i lam// spros dang bral ba mthong ba'i lam// rtogs pa skyes pa sgom pa'i lam// ro gcig pa ni sa brgyad pa// sgom med bcu gcig mthar phyin lam// zhes sogs dang*/ yang ji skad du// sngon 'gro tshogs lam rtse gcig ni// sbyor ba'i lam ste 'jig rten pa// spros bral chung ngu mthong ba'i lam// 'bring nas ro gcig chen po'i bar// ma dag sa bdun sgom med kyi// dang po gsum po dag pa'i sa// mtha' ma nyag gcig sangs rgyas te// rnal 'byor bzhir dbye'i dang po nas// bzhi yan rtse gcig spros bral ni// lnga drug kho na lhag ma las// mtha' ma ma gtogs ro gcig go /bcu gnyis dbye na dang po gnyis// chung ngu 'bring dang chen po dang*// lnga drug chung ngu bdun pa ni// 'bring po brgyad pa chen po dang*// dgu pa chung ngu bcu pa 'bring*// bcu gcig bcu gnyis chen po dang*// bcu gsum chung ngu bcu bzhi dang*// bco lnga 'bring ste mtha' ma ni// chen por gsal bar shog khrar ltos// gong ma'i gsung dang mthun na longs// mi mthun ring du dor bar byos//

sngon 'gro'i chos thams cad rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor spros bral gyi rnal 'byor ro gcig gi rnal 'byor sgom med kyi rnal 'byor tshogs lam sbyor lam mthong lam sgom lam mi slob pa'i lam 1 rtse gcig gi rtse gcig /chung ngu sbyor lam drod 5 spros bral gyi rtse gcig /chung ngu*/ mthong laṃ sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag gi ye shes 9 ro gcig gi rtse gcig /chung ngu*/ sgom lam sa bzhi pa 13 sgom med kyi rtse gcig /chung ngu*/ sgom lam sa brgyad pa 2 rtse gcig gi spros bral/ chung ngu*/ sbyor lam rtse mo 6 spros bral gyi spros bral/ chung ngu*/ mthong laṃ sa dang po'i rjes thob kyi ye shes 10 ro gcig gi spros bral/ 'bring po/ sgom lam sa lnga pa 14 sgom med kyi spros bral/ 'bring po/ sgom lam sa dgu pa 3 rtse gcig gi ro gcig /'bring po/ sbyor lam bzod pa 7 spros bral gyi ro gcig /'bring po/ sgom lam sa gnyis pa 11 ro gcig gi ro gcig /chen po/ sgom lam sa drug pa 15 sgom med kyi ro gcig / 'bring po/ sgom lam sa bcu pa 4 rtse gcig gi sgom med/ chen po/ sbyor lam chos mchog 8 spros bral gyi sgom med/ chen po/ sgom lam sa gsum pa 12 ro gcig gi sgom med/ chen po/ sgom lam sa bdun pa 16 sgom med kyi sgom med/ chen po/ mi slob lam sangs rgyas kyi sa/ de dag gi rnam bzhag dpyis phyin par ni/ 'dir rjod byed kyi tshig nyung ngus bkral bar byed mi nus pas/ dpal 'brug pa yab sras brgyud pa'i gsung rab las shes par bya'o// des phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dngos gzhi'i khrid zin gyi dgongs don mdo tsam bshad zin to// slar smras pa/ oṃ swa sti/ zung 'jug chen po'i mkha' la gnas bcas te// nges gsang gdams pa'i rnga sgra ci yang gis// 'gro kun gnyid las slong pa'i cho ga mkhan// 'brug chen ngag dbang nor bu spyi bor mchod// gang de'i khrid gzhung dgongs don sa 'og gter// bdag 'dra byis blo'i mig gi ma mthong bzhin// tshig 'bru'i dbyig 'dzin khung bur brus pa'i 'bras/

nongs pa'i rdul gyis rang rgyud sbags las ci// 'on kyang dam pas btang ba'i grogs dag gis// bskul ngag dbyug gus lan brgyar bsnun pa'i mthus// sbubs stong rnga gog rang mtshang 'byin pa'i sgra// sgrog pa'i nyes tshogs 'khor lo'i mgon la bshags// 'dir 'bad kyis mtshon dge tshogs zla ba'i chus// 'gro kun snyigs lnga'i tsha gdung yongs bcil nas// rdzogs ldan ku mud gsar du bzhad pa'i nang*// thub bstan zil mngar dar rgyas yun gnas shog /lhag par dgongs brgyud gdams pa'i gru char 'dis// 'gro kun gnas rigs sa bon brlan pa'i mod// rgyas 'gyur myu gu cig car bskyed bsrings nas// sku bzhi'i 'bras smin don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang*/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ bka' drin gsum ldan ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho gtso bor gyur pa'i dpal mgon bla ma du ma'i zhal snga nas// phyag rgya chen po'i zab khrid rgyas bsdus ci yang stsal ba thos pas glo ba dga' tsam ma gtogs/ gshis skye med la brtan pa ma thob cing gdangs 'gag med nyams rtsal ma sbyang pas/ sgom nyams kyi yon tan rdul phran tsam yang med pa'i dred po phyir ldir nang stong bdag lta bus/ kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i phyag chen dngos gzhi'i zin thun gyi dgongs don zab mo go yul 'ud gog 'thag pa'i 'chad rtsom bgyir mi rung mod/ 'on kyang rang mnyam blo rtul du mas yang nas yang du bskul ba'i re skong tsam du/ sgrub brgyud gong ma'i gsung rab dang bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas shākya'i dge slong spong ba'i brtul zhugs can yon tan 'od dam bstan 'dzin don kun grub pa'i sdes rang lo zhe dgu'i thog tu son pa nyal 'gro'i khams ldan khyu mchog gi lo/ sgrub sde nges don dga' tshal gyi yang dben 'od gsal chos gling du bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/
